title: GroundingPI: A Grounding Foundation Model towards Physical Intelligence with Visual Primitives
title_zh: GroundingPI：以视觉基元迈向物理智能的定位基础模型

paragraphs.en: Precise grounding matters. It specifies which object is the target and where that object is, even in clutter and for tiny objects, and it has to be fast enough for closed-loop control. Yet vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAMs) take perception from general-purpose vision-language and video-generation backbones, which still fail in these settings. We introduce GroundingPI, a 4B grounding foundation model that generates points and boxes as quantized coordinates in a shared vocabulary. Training combines multimodal and spatial pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning with GRPO, using supervision from public datasets and dedicated data engines. Against 44 baselines across 34 grounding benchmarks spanning 11 perceptual capabilities, GroundingPI establishes a new state of the art, averaging 73.68%, above the larger GPT-6 Astra (71.54%). As a downstream visual backbone, GroundingPI improves performance on robotic manipulation and autonomous driving. On RoboTwin 2.0, it outperforms every mainstream backbone we evaluate in all four out-of-distribution settings, by up to 24.8% relative to the strongest backbone. On RoboCasa-GR1, GroundingPI trained with 50% of the demonstrations outperforms those baselines trained with 75%. On nuScenes, used as the visual backbone, GroundingPI attains an average open-loop L2 error of 0.296 m. We systematically analyze GroundingPI’s pretraining in scale and data composition. Downstream autonomous driving and robotic manipulation improve as the pretraining is scaled. Analyzing the data recipe across these 11 perceptual capabilities shows dense grounding’s substantial benefits for both, and OCR’s potential as a catalyst for perceptual learning. These results support grounding as a perceptual foundation, and dedicated perceptual pretraining as a promising direction for foundation models of physical intelligence.
paragraphs.zh: 精准的定位（grounding）至关重要。 它需要指明哪个对象是目标以及该对象位于何处，即使在杂乱场景和微小物体的情况下也要如此，并且其速度必须足够快以支持闭环控制。 然而，视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型和世界-动作模型（WAMs）的感知能力来自通用的视觉-语言与视频生成骨干模型，而这些骨干模型在上述场景中仍然会失败。 我们提出 GroundingPI，一个 4B 规模的定位基础模型，它以共享词表中的量化坐标形式生成点与框。 其训练结合了多模态与空间预训练、有监督微调，以及基于 GRPO 的强化学习，监督信号来自公开数据集和专用数据引擎。 在跨越 11 项感知能力的 34 个定位基准上对比 44 个基线模型，GroundingPI 创立了新的最先进水平，平均达到 73.68%，高于更大的 GPT-6 Astra（71.54%）。 作为下游视觉骨干模型，GroundingPI 提升了机器人操作与自动驾驶的性能。 在 RoboTwin 2.0 上，在我们评估的所有四种分布外设置中，它都优于所有主流骨干模型，相对最强骨干模型最高领先 24.8%。 在 RoboCasa-GR1 上，仅用 50% 演示数据训练的 GroundingPI 超过了用 75% 演示数据训练的那些基线模型。 在 nuScenes 上作为视觉骨干模型使用时，GroundingPI 取得了平均 0.296 米的开环 L2 误差。 我们系统地分析了 GroundingPI 预训练在规模和数据组成方面的表现。 随着预训练规模的扩大，下游的自动驾驶与机器人操作性能也随之提升。 对这 11 项感知能力的数据配方进行分析表明，密集定位对两者都有显著收益，而 OCR 则具有作为感知学习催化剂的潜力。 这些结果支持将定位作为感知基础，并表明专门的感知预训练是物理智能基础模型的一个有前景的方向。

paragraphs.en: Visual grounding connects language to objects, locations, and interaction-relevant structures, making it a core perceptual capability of vision-language models (VLMs). Despite recent progress in grounding UI elements ( Lin et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) , regions ( Lai et al., 2024 ; Ren et al., 2024 ) , and task-relevant entities ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) , achieving broad and precise grounding for physical intelligence ( Black et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Kim et al., 2024 ) remains challenging.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉定位将语言与物体、位置以及与交互相关的结构联系起来，使其成为视觉语言模型（VLM）的一项核心感知能力。 尽管近期在定位 UI 元素（Lin et al., 2024；Liu et al., 2025）、区域（Lai et al., 2024；Ren et al., 2024）以及任务相关实体（Zhang et al., 2023；Jiang et al., 2026；Yu et al., 2025）方面取得了进展，但为物理智能（Black et al., 2024；Wang et al., 2026b；Kim et al., 2024）实现广泛而精确的定位仍然具有挑战性。

sents.zh: 尽管近期在定位 UI 元素（Lin et al., 2024；Liu et al., 2025）、区域（Lai et al., 2024；Ren et al., 2024）以及任务相关实体（Zhang et al., 2023；Jiang et al., 2026；Yu et al., 2025）方面取得了进展，但为物理智能（Black et al., 2024；Wang et al., 2026b；Kim et al., 2024）实现广泛而精确的定位仍然具有挑战性。

paragraphs.en: When tidying a cluttered desk, one finds the mug and its handle before deciding how to grasp and move it, establishing where to act before determining how to act . Vision-language-action (VLA) models ( Kim et al., 2024 ; Black et al., 2024 ; NVIDIA et al., 2025 ) and world-action models (WAMs) ( Kim et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) increasingly build on general-purpose vision-language and video-generation backbones. However, these backbones are not primarily optimized for the precise grounding required by physical interaction and leave perception as a bottleneck for downstream action learning.
paragraphs.zh: 在整理一张凌乱的书桌时，人们会先找到马克杯及其把手，再决定如何抓取和移动它，即先确定在哪里行动，再决定如何行动。 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型（Kim et al., 2024；Black et al., 2024；NVIDIA et al., 2025）和世界-动作模型（WAM）（Kim et al., 2026；Ye et al., 2026；Wang et al., 2026b）越来越多地构建在通用的视觉-语言和视频生成主干之上。 然而，这些主干并未针对物理交互所需的精确定位进行优化，使感知成为下游动作学习的瓶颈。

sents.zh: 然而，这些主干并未针对物理交互所需的精确定位进行优化，使感知成为下游动作学习的瓶颈。

paragraphs.en: Our evaluations reveal substantial weaknesses in general-purpose VLMs and considerable room for improvement in dedicated models such as Rex-Omni and LocateAnything ( Jiang et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) . These limitations are particularly evident in demanding settings such as dense scenes and tiny objects, where Qwen3.5 models struggle and even GPT-6 Astra leaves room for improvement. Such perceptual gaps can leave scarce action data responsible for both perceptual and action learning. Compute and latency constraints further limit reliance on larger backbones for action execution ( NVIDIA et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026b ) . These gaps motivate building a more capable grounding foundation model.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的评估揭示了一般用途视觉语言模型的显著弱点，以及 Rex-Omni 和 LocateAnything 等专用模型仍有相当大的改进空间（Jiang et al., 2026; Wang et al., 2026a）。 这些局限在密集场景和微小物体等严苛环境中尤为明显，Qwen3.5 系列模型在此表现挣扎，即使是 GPT-6 Astra 也仍有改进余地。 这样的感知差距可能使稀缺的动作数据同时承担感知学习和动作学习的任务。 计算和时延约束进一步限制了在动作执行上依赖更大的主干网络（NVIDIA et al., 2025; Chen et al., 2026b）。 这些差距促使我们构建一个能力更强的定位基础模型。

We argue that a more natural and scalable approach is to develop strong grounding as a native capability of the foundation model. We pursue a grounding foundation model built on visual primitives, aiming to advance broad, precise perception and investigate its value for physical intelligence. We ask:

paragraphs.en: To address these questions, we introduce GroundingPI , a 4B-parameter grounding foundation model for a broad range of perception tasks, built on visual primitives including points and bounding boxes. A shared vocabulary with quantized coordinates unifies diverse perception tasks as language-conditioned structured generation, covering grounding, referring, pointing, OCR, GUI and layout grounding, and visual prompting ( ). Training combines multimodal and spatial pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning with GRPO, using supervision from public datasets and dedicated data engines.
paragraphs.zh: 为解答这些问题，我们提出 GroundingPI，一个面向广泛感知任务、基于点与边界框等视觉基元的 40 亿参数定位基础模型。 带有量化坐标的共享词汇表将多样的感知任务统一为语言条件下的结构化生成，涵盖定位、指代、指点、OCR、GUI 与版面定位，以及视觉提示（ ）。 训练结合了多模态与空间预训练、监督微调，以及基于 GRPO 的强化学习，监督信号来自公开数据集和专用数据引擎。

paragraphs.en: Evaluated against 44 baselines across 34 grounding benchmarks spanning 11 perceptual capabilities, GroundingPI achieves 73.68% on average, establishing a new state of the art, averaging 73.68%, above the larger GPT-6 Astra (71.54%). We compare with GPT-6 Astra specifically to explore the potential and limits of improving basic perceptual performance. We further evaluate transfer to autonomous driving on nuScenes and robotic manipulation on RoboTwin 2.0 and RoboCasa-GR1. Within each manipulation benchmark, we fix the Action DiT, action data, and training budget. GroundingPI demonstrates strong transfer to physical intelligence tasks, consistently outperforming all evaluated mainstream backbones, in all four OOD settings, with relative improvements of up to 24.8% over the strongest baseline. Action-data efficiency also improves in robotic manipulation: on RoboCasa-GR1, GroundingPI trained with 50% of demonstrations outperforms all compared baselines trained with 75%. These results support the value of a stronger perceptual foundation for downstream action learning.
paragraphs.zh: 在涵盖 11 种感知能力的 34 个接地基准上与 44 个基线对比评估后，GroundingPI 平均达到 73.68%，创下新的最先进水平，平均 73.68% 高于更大的 GPT-6 Astra（71.54%）。 我们专门与 GPT-6 Astra 进行比较，以探索提升基础感知性能的潜力与极限。 我们进一步评估了向自动驾驶（nuScenes）以及机器人操作（RoboTwin 2.0 和 RoboCasa-GR1）的迁移能力。 在每个操作基准中，我们固定 Action DiT、动作数据和训练预算。 GroundingPI 展现出向物理智能任务的强大迁移能力，在所有四种 OOD 设置中始终优于所有被评估的主流骨干模型，相对于最强基线的相对提升最高达 24.8%。 机器人操作中的动作数据效率也有所提升：在 RoboCasa-GR1 上，仅用 50% 演示数据训练的 GroundingPI 优于所有用 75% 数据训练的对比基线。 这些结果支持了更强的感知基础对下游动作学习的价值。

sents.zh: 在涵盖 11 种感知能力的 34 个接地基准上与 44 个基线对比评估后，GroundingPI 平均达到 73.68%，创下新的最先进水平，平均 73.68% 高于更大的 GPT-6 Astra（71.54%）。

sents.en: We compare with GPT-6 Astra specifically to explore the potential and limits of improving basic perceptual performance.
sents.zh: 我们专门与 GPT-6 Astra 进行比较，以探索提升基础感知性能的潜力与极限。

sents.en: We further evaluate transfer to autonomous driving on nuScenes and robotic manipulation on RoboTwin 2.0 and RoboCasa-GR1.
sents.zh: 我们进一步评估了向自动驾驶（nuScenes）以及机器人操作（RoboTwin 2.0 和 RoboCasa-GR1）的迁移能力。

sents.en: Within each manipulation benchmark, we fix the Action DiT, action data, and training budget.
sents.zh: 在每个操作基准中，我们固定 Action DiT、动作数据和训练预算。

sents.en: GroundingPI demonstrates strong transfer to physical intelligence tasks, consistently outperforming all evaluated mainstream backbones, in all four OOD settings, with relative improvements of up to 24.8% over the strongest baseline.
sents.zh: GroundingPI 展现出向物理智能任务的强大迁移能力，在所有四种 OOD 设置中始终优于所有被评估的主流骨干模型，相对于最强基线的相对提升最高达 24.8%。

sents.en: Action-data efficiency also improves in robotic manipulation: on RoboCasa-GR1, GroundingPI trained with 50% of demonstrations outperforms all compared baselines trained with 75%.
sents.zh: 机器人操作中的动作数据效率也有所提升：在 RoboCasa-GR1 上，仅用 50% 演示数据训练的 GroundingPI 优于所有用 75% 数据训练的对比基线。

sents.en: These results support the value of a stronger perceptual foundation for downstream action learning.
sents.zh: 这些结果支持了更强的感知基础对下游动作学习的价值。

paragraphs.en: Our analyses offer insights into perceptual pretraining and the design of embodied foundation models. Scaling and data ablations show that both pretraining scale and data composition matter for grounding and downstream transfer. Basic grounding provides an important foundation, dense grounding substantially benefits autonomous driving and robotic manipulation, and OCR shows potential as a catalyst for perceptual learning. Our design insights focus on perceptual foundations for System-1-style execution ( NVIDIA et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026b ) . We discuss possible directions for designing such embodied foundation models to complement the high-level reasoning and planning of frontier models such as Astra. Visual primitives may further enable physical prompting, specifying targets, locations, and structures alongside language.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的分析为感知预训练以及具身基础模型的设计提供了洞见。 规模与数据消融实验表明，预训练规模和数据构成对基础接地（grounding）及下游迁移都很重要。 基础接地提供了重要的基础，密集接地对自动驾驶和机器人操作大有裨益，而 OCR 则有望成为感知学习的催化剂。 我们的设计洞见聚焦于面向 System-1 式执行的感知基础 ( NVIDIA et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026b ) 。 我们讨论了设计此类具身基础模型的可能方向，以补充 Astra 等前沿模型的高层推理与规划能力。 视觉原语还可以进一步实现物理提示，与语言一同指定目标、位置和结构。

paragraphs.en: In summary, our major contributions are as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 总结而言，我们的主要贡献如下：

paragraphs.en: A strong grounding foundation model. We introduce GroundingPI, a 4B model built on visual primitives, with a staged training recipe and state-of-the-art grounding performance.
paragraphs.zh: 一个强大的 grounding 基础模型。 我们提出了 GroundingPI，一个基于视觉原语构建的 4B 智能体模型，采用分阶段训练配方，并具备最先进的 grounding 性能。

sents.en: A strong grounding foundation model.
sents.zh: 一个强大的 grounding 基础模型。

sents.en: We introduce GroundingPI, a 4B model built on visual primitives, with a staged training recipe and state-of-the-art grounding performance.
sents.zh: 我们提出了 GroundingPI，一个基于视觉原语构建的 4B 智能体模型，采用分阶段训练配方，并具备最先进的 grounding 性能。

paragraphs.en: Transfer toward physical intelligence. Autonomous driving and robotic manipulation evaluations demonstrate the value of this perceptual foundation, including strong ID and OOD performance and improved action-data efficiency.
paragraphs.zh: 迈向物理智能的迁移。 自动驾驶与机器人操作的评估展示了这一感知基础的价值，包括强大的同分布（ID）与分布外（OOD）性能以及更高的动作数据效率。

sents.en: Transfer toward physical intelligence.
sents.zh: 迈向物理智能的迁移。

sents.en: Autonomous driving and robotic manipulation evaluations demonstrate the value of this perceptual foundation, including strong ID and OOD performance and improved action-data efficiency.
sents.zh: 自动驾驶与机器人操作的评估展示了这一感知基础的价值，包括强大的同分布（ID）与分布外（OOD）性能以及更高的动作数据效率。

paragraphs.en: Insights into perceptual pretraining and future embodied paradigms. We analyze how pretraining scale and data composition shape grounding and transfer, and discuss implications for System-1 foundation-model design and its complementary role in future embodied systems.
paragraphs.zh: 对感知预训练与未来具身范式的洞见。 我们分析了预训练规模与数据构成如何塑造接地能力与迁移能力，并讨论了其对系统一基础模型设计的启示及其在未来具身系统中的互补作用。

sents.en: Insights into perceptual pretraining and future embodied paradigms.
sents.zh: 对感知预训练与未来具身范式的洞见。

sents.en: We analyze how pretraining scale and data composition shape grounding and transfer, and discuss implications for System-1 foundation-model design and its complementary role in future embodied systems.
sents.zh: 我们分析了预训练规模与数据构成如何塑造接地能力与迁移能力，并讨论了其对系统一基础模型设计的启示及其在未来具身系统中的互补作用。

paragraphs.en: Visual grounding has evolved from closed-set object detection ( Redmon et al., 2016 ; Carion et al., 2020 ) to language-conditioned localization beyond fixed vocabularies through grounded image-text pretraining ( Li et al., 2022 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) . Generative grounding models adopt autoregressive next-token prediction to produce labels and quantized coordinates as structured sequences, providing a shared interface across diverse perception tasks ( Chen et al., 2022 ; Xiao et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) , while LocateAnything explores precise grounding with parallel box decoding ( Jiang et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) . Spatial affordance prediction and spatial referring extend these capabilities toward robotic interaction ( Yuan et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) . These advances motivate studying broad and precise grounding as a transferable perceptual foundation for physical intelligence.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉定位已从闭集目标检测（Redmon et al., 2016；Carion et al., 2020）发展到通过图文定位预训练（Li et al., 2022；Liu et al., 2024）实现超越固定词表的语言条件定位。 生成式定位模型采用自回归的下一词预测，以结构化序列的形式生成标签和量化坐标，为多样的感知任务提供统一接口（Chen et al., 2022；Xiao et al., 2024；Jiang et al., 2026），而 LocateAnything 则探索基于并行框解码的精确定位（Jiang et al., 2026；Wang et al., 2026a）。 空间可供性预测与空间指代将这些能力进一步拓展至机器人交互领域（Yuan et al., 2024；Zhou et al., 2026；Wu et al., 2026）。 这些进展促使我们研究广泛且精确的定位，将其作为面向具身智能的可迁移感知基础。

paragraphs.en: Physical-intelligence models increasingly inherit complementary priors from large-scale pretraining. VLA models build on VLMs to transfer broad visual-semantic knowledge and language grounding ( Kim et al., 2024 ; Black et al., 2024 ) , while WAMs adapt video and world models to leverage spatiotemporal and visual-dynamics priors ( Kim et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) . Embodied foundation models further combine semantic, dynamic, and embodied experience toward more general physical intelligence ( Intelligence et al., 2025 ; NVIDIA et al., 2025 ; Dang et al., 2026 ; NVIDIA, 2026 ) . However, these broad capabilities do not necessarily provide the precise, task-conditioned perception required for physical interaction, leaving a capability mismatch between pretraining and action learning. Together, this capability mismatch motivates closer study of how precise perception can support action learning.
paragraphs.zh: 物理智能模型日益从大规模预训练中继承互补的先验知识。 VLA 模型构建在 VLM 之上，以迁移广泛的视觉-语义知识和语言接地（Kim et al., 2024；Black et al., 2024），而 WAM 则改造视频模型和世界模型，以利用时空与视觉动态先验（Kim et al., 2026；Ye et al., 2026；Wang et al., 2026b）。 具身基础模型进一步融合语义、动态与具身经验，迈向更通用的物理智能（Intelligence et al., 2025；NVIDIA et al., 2025；Dang et al., 2026；NVIDIA, 2026）。 然而，这些宽泛的能力并不一定能提供物理交互所需的精确的、任务条件化的感知，从而在预训练与动作学习之间留下了能力错配。 总之，这种能力错配促使我们更深入地研究精确感知如何支持动作学习。

sents.en: Together, this capability mismatch motivates closer study of how precise perception can support action learning.
sents.zh: 总之，这种能力错配促使我们更深入地研究精确感知如何支持动作学习。

paragraphs.en: Recent policy recipes strengthen perception through bounding-box prediction, task-relevant region reconstruction, affordance representations, and spatial auxiliary supervision ( Intelligence et al., 2025 ; Song et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2026 ; Tu et al., 2026 ; You et al., 2026 ; Shen et al., 2026 ) . These approaches demonstrate the value of perception, but usually introduce it as a task-specific proxy, auxiliary objective, or intermediate representation within action learning. Such mechanisms cover selected perceptual signals, often depend on additional annotations or policy-specific components, and are difficult to scale across the diverse scenes and perceptual demands of physical intelligence. Together, these limitations motivate a perception-native foundation model: one that learns broad and precise perception before action adaptation, so downstream policies can build on perception rather than recover it from task-specific proxies.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的策略方案通过边界框预测、任务相关区域重建、可供性表示以及空间辅助监督来增强感知（Intelligence et al., 2025；Song et al., 2026；Yu et al., 2026；Tu et al., 2026；You et al., 2026；Shen et al., 2026）。 这些方法证明了感知的价值，但通常将感知作为动作学习中的任务特定代理、辅助目标或中间表示来引入。 这类机制仅覆盖部分被选择的感知信号，往往依赖额外的标注或策略特定的组件，难以在物理智能的多样化场景和感知需求之间进行扩展。 综上所述，这些局限性催生了对感知原生基础模型的需求：即在动作适配之前学习广泛而精确的感知，使下游智能体策略能够建立在感知之上，而不是从任务特定的代理中重新恢复感知。

paragraphs.en: GroundingPI is an autoregressive grounding foundation model for language-conditioned perception. As shown in Figure 1 , it couples a MoonViT-V2 (Kimi K3) visual encoder ( Team et al., 2026 ) with a Qwen3-4B language decoder ( Yang et al., 2025a ) . A learnable projector aggregates adjacent 2 × 2 2\times 2 visual features and maps them to the language embedding space through a two-layer MLP with GELU and output normalization.
paragraphs.zh: GroundingPI 是一个用于语言条件感知的自回归定位基础模型。 如图 1 所示，它将 MoonViT-V2（Kimi K3）视觉编码器（Team 等，2026）与 Qwen3-4B 语言解码器（Yang 等，2025a）相耦合。 一个可学习的投影器聚合相邻的 2 × 2 2\times 2 视觉特征，并通过一个带有 GELU 和输出归一化的两层 MLP 将其映射到语言嵌入空间。

sents.en: GroundingPI is an autoregressive grounding foundation model for language-conditioned perception.

paragraphs.en: Training data combines public datasets with annotations produced by our data engine.
paragraphs.zh: 训练数据结合了公开数据集与由我们的数据引擎生成的标注。

paragraphs.en: Our data engine fuses multi-teacher annotations at the field level and applies task-specific validation ( Figure 2 ). Accepted labels train a unified grounding expert for iterative annotation, while complementary teachers and local observations resolve uncertain cases to expand supervision and refine existing labels. Field validation, task dependencies, and label revision are detailed in Section 7.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的数据引擎在字段级别融合多教师标注，并应用任务特定的验证（图 2）。 被接受的标签用于训练一个统一的基础定位专家进行迭代标注，同时互补教师和局部观察用于解决不确定案例，以扩展监督并修正现有标签。 字段验证、任务依赖关系和标签修正将在第 7.3 节中详细介绍。

sents.en: Our data engine fuses multi-teacher annotations at the field level and applies task-specific validation ( Figure 2 ).
sents.zh: 我们的数据引擎在字段级别融合多教师标注，并应用任务特定的验证（图 2）。

sents.en: Accepted labels train a unified grounding expert for iterative annotation, while complementary teachers and local observations resolve uncertain cases to expand supervision and refine existing labels.

sents.en: Field validation, task dependencies, and label revision are detailed in Section 7.3 .

paragraphs.en: Base training first aligns the projector using image-caption supervision while freezing both backbones. It then updates all modules in two stages: joint multimodal pretraining on text and image–text supervision, followed by general visual/video understanding through question answering and captioning. All stages use causal next-token prediction. Loss normalization and optimization details are provided in Section 7.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 基础训练阶段首先在冻结两个主干网络的情况下，使用图像-文本描述（caption）监督来对齐投影器。 随后分两个阶段更新所有模块：先基于文本和图文监督进行联合多模态预训练，再通过问答和描述任务实现通用的视觉/视频理解。 所有阶段均采用因果的下一词元预测。 损失归一化与优化细节见第 7.4 节。

sents.zh: 损失归一化与优化细节见第 7.4 节。

paragraphs.en: SFT aligns coordinates with visual locations and learns the shared output protocol. Supervised adaptation first updates all modules, then freezes the vision encoder and projector for language-side refinement. Module schedules and hyperparameters are given in Section 7.4 .

paragraphs.en: To directly optimize localization, target coverage, and text–geometry consistency, we apply group relative policy optimization (GRPO) ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Ping et al., 2026 ) with G = 8 G=8 autoregressive responses per image–query pair ( Figure 3 ). For grounding, R set R_{\mathrm{set}} measures coverage through reference-wise maximum-IoU matching with class validation. The complementary R strict R_{\mathrm{strict}} combines multi-threshold F1, localization, format, count, and ordering scores, penalizing duplicate and oversized boxes. The independently standardized rewards yield A ~ i = 0.7 ​ Z ​ ( R set , i ) + 0.3 ​ Z ​ ( R strict , i ) \widetilde{A}_{i}=0.7Z(R_{\mathrm{set},i})+0.3Z(R_{\mathrm{strict},i}) . For OCR, Hungarian one-to-one matching evaluates text and geometry across complete word/line views or complementary references. Format gating and output penalties produce one composite reward, giving A ~ i = Z ⁡ ( R OCR , i ) \widetilde{A}_{i}=Z(R_{\mathrm{OCR},i}) . Here Z Z standardizes each active reward within a prompt; the combined advantages are then standardized across the response batch. We optimize the clipped GRPO objective with a frozen SFT reference, updating only language parameters. Reward definitions and optimization details are provided in Sections 7.6.1 , 7.6.2 and 7.6 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了直接优化定位、目标覆盖以及文本与几何的一致性，我们对每个图像–查询对应用组相对策略优化（GRPO）（Shao et al., 2024；Ping et al., 2026），每个图像–查询对生成 G=8 个自回归响应（图 3）。 对于接地任务，集合奖励 R_{\mathrm{set}} 通过带类别验证的逐引用最大 IoU 匹配来衡量覆盖率。 互补的严格奖励 R_{\mathrm{strict}} 结合多阈值 F1、定位、格式、计数和排序分数，并对重复框和过大框进行惩罚。 经独立标准化的奖励得到 \widetilde{A}_{i}=0.7Z(R_{\mathrm{set},i})+0.3Z(R_{\mathrm{strict},i})。 对于 OCR 任务，匈牙利一对一匹配在完整词/行视图或互补引用上评估文本与几何。 格式门控与输出惩罚共同产生一个综合奖励，得到 \widetilde{A}_{i}=Z(R_{\mathrm{OCR},i})。 其中 Z 在每个提示内对各激活奖励进行标准化；随后组合优势在响应批次间进行标准化。 我们在冻结的 SFT 参考模型下优化带裁剪的 GRPO 目标，仅更新语言参数。 奖励定义与优化细节见第 7.6.1、7.6.2 和 7.6 节。

paragraphs.en: GroundingPI provides a strong perceptual interface for action learning. We study whether its precise, language-conditioned grounding representations translate into stronger action-learning capabilities in two downstream physical-intelligence paradigms: trajectory prediction for autonomous driving and continuous control for robot manipulation. Each domain retains its native action learner, while GroundingPI serves as the shared perceptual foundation.
paragraphs.zh: GroundingPI 为动作学习提供了强大的感知接口。 我们在两个下游物理智能范式——自动驾驶的轨迹预测和机器人操作的连续控制——中研究其精确的、语言条件化的接地表征能否转化为更强的动作学习能力。 每个领域保留其原生的动作学习器，而 GroundingPI 则作为共享的感知基础。

sents.en: GroundingPI provides a strong perceptual interface for action learning.
sents.zh: GroundingPI 为动作学习提供了强大的感知接口。

sents.en: We study whether its precise, language-conditioned grounding representations translate into stronger action-learning capabilities in two downstream physical-intelligence paradigms: trajectory prediction for autonomous driving and continuous control for robot manipulation.
sents.zh: 我们在两个下游物理智能范式——自动驾驶的轨迹预测和机器人操作的连续控制——中研究其精确的、语言条件化的接地表征能否转化为更强的动作学习能力。

sents.en: Each domain retains its native action learner, while GroundingPI serves as the shared perceptual foundation.
sents.zh: 每个领域保留其原生的动作学习器，而 GroundingPI 则作为共享的感知基础。

paragraphs.en: We formulate autonomous driving on nuScenes ( Caesar et al., 2020 ) as language-conditioned trajectory prediction ( ). Given the current front-camera image and historical ego states, the token-based interface represents the future trajectory as six ordered waypoints at 0.5-second intervals over a three-second horizon. Each waypoint specifies a cumulative position in the current ego frame, with forward and left axes measured in meters. Fixed metric ranges map these coordinates to GroundingPI’s existing <0> – <999> vocabulary. The language head generates the trajectory autoregressively, and response-only cross-entropy provides the adaptation objective. Decoding recovers metric waypoints while preserving their temporal order. Coordinate conventions and the open-loop L2 metric are detailed in Section 8.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们将在 nuScenes（Caesar et al., 2020）上的自动驾驶表述为语言条件化的轨迹预测（ ）。 给定当前前视相机图像和历史自车状态，基于 token 的接口将未来轨迹表示为三秒时间范围内以 0.5 秒为间隔的六个有序路径点。 每个路径点指定在当前自车坐标系下的累积位置，前向和左向轴以米为单位度量。 固定的度量范围将这些坐标映射到 GroundingPI 现有的 <0>–<999> 词表。 语言头以自回归方式生成轨迹，仅针对响应的交叉熵提供适配目标。 解码在恢复度量路径点的同时保留其时间顺序。 坐标约定和开环 L2 指标详见第 8.1 节。

paragraphs.en: For robot manipulation, we follow the π \pi -style flow-matching policy ( Black et al., 2024 ) and adopt the layer-wise connection used in StarVLA ( Community, 2026 ) ( ). The pretrained foundation encodes the visual observation and language instruction once; its intermediate features are projected and resampled, then injected into the corresponding cross-attention layers of an Action DiT. Conditioned on these features and the robot state, the action expert denoises a noisy action chunk into continuous controls.
paragraphs.zh: 对于机器人操作，我们采用 π \pi 风格的流匹配策略（ Black et al., 2024 ），并采用 StarVLA（ Community, 2026 ）中使用的逐层连接方式（ ）。 预训练基础模型对视觉观测和语言指令进行一次编码；其中间特征经过投影和重采样后，被注入到 Action DiT 中相应的交叉注意力层。 以这些特征和机器人状态为条件，动作专家将含噪的动作块去噪为连续控制信号。

sents.en: For robot manipulation, we follow the π \pi -style flow-matching policy ( Black et al., 2024 ) and adopt the layer-wise connection used in StarVLA ( Community, 2026 ) ( ).
sents.zh: 对于机器人操作，我们采用 π \pi 风格的流匹配策略（ Black et al., 2024 ），并采用 StarVLA（ Community, 2026 ）中使用的逐层连接方式（ ）。

sents.zh: 以这些特征和机器人状态为条件，动作专家将含噪的动作块去噪为连续控制信号。

paragraphs.en: To compare perceptual foundations under the same action-learning setup, we follow the two adaptation pathways implemented in StarVLA: Wan- π \pi for video-generation backbones and the StarVLA π \pi -style pathway for vision-language foundations. This yields four controlled model families: general-purpose vision-language models , video-generation backbones , grounding models , and embodied foundation models . Within each benchmark, we keep the Action DiT, robot data, action representation, optimization budget, and inference procedure fixed, varying only the pretrained foundation. We compare their action acquisition and generalization, with full implementation details in Section 8.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了在同一动作学习设置下比较感知基础，我们遵循 StarVLA 中实现的两种适配路径：面向视频生成骨干的 Wan-π \pi 路径，以及面向视觉-语言基础的 StarVLA π \pi 风格路径。 这得到了四个受控模型家族：通用视觉-语言模型、视频生成骨干、接地模型和具身基础模型。 在每个基准中，我们保持动作 DiT、机器人数据、动作表示、优化预算和推理流程不变，仅改变预训练基础模型。 我们比较它们的动作获取与泛化能力，完整实现细节见第 8.2 节。

sents.en: To compare perceptual foundations under the same action-learning setup, we follow the two adaptation pathways implemented in StarVLA: Wan- π \pi for video-generation backbones and the StarVLA π \pi -style pathway for vision-language foundations.
sents.zh: 为了在同一动作学习设置下比较感知基础，我们遵循 StarVLA 中实现的两种适配路径：面向视频生成骨干的 Wan-π \pi 路径，以及面向视觉-语言基础的 StarVLA π \pi 风格路径。

sents.zh: 这得到了四个受控模型家族：通用视觉-语言模型、视频生成骨干、接地模型和具身基础模型。

sents.en: Within each benchmark, we keep the Action DiT, robot data, action representation, optimization budget, and inference procedure fixed, varying only the pretrained foundation.
sents.zh: 在每个基准中，我们保持动作 DiT、机器人数据、动作表示、优化预算和推理流程不变，仅改变预训练基础模型。

sents.en: We compare their action acquisition and generalization, with full implementation details in Section 8.2 .
sents.zh: 我们比较它们的动作获取与泛化能力，完整实现细节见第 8.2 节。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate GroundingPI against 44 baselines on 34 benchmarks spanning 11 perceptual capabilities, covering specialized detectors, general-purpose VLMs, grounding specialists, and embodied foundations. All numerical results and conclusions involving our models are based on the mean of ten runs, using five random seeds with two runs per seed. Owing to the high computational cost, other baselines that we evaluate locally for the main leaderboard are averaged over three runs, using three random seeds with one run per seed. GPT-6 Astra is evaluated with thinking effort set to High . We use F1mIoU for box grounding and OCR, F1@Point for object pointing, and task-specific accuracy for spatial and robo and GUI grounding.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在涵盖 11 项感知能力的 34 个基准上将 GroundingPI 与 44 个基线进行对比评估，这些基线包括专用检测器、通用 VLM、定位专项模型和具身基础模型。 所有涉及我们模型的数值结果和结论均基于十次运行的平均值，即使用五个随机种子、每个种子运行两次。 由于计算成本较高，我们在主排行榜上于本地评估的其他基线均基于三次运行的平均值，即使用三个随机种子、每个种子运行一次。 GPT-6 Astra 的评估将思考力度（thinking effort）设置为 High。 我们对边界框定位和 OCR 使用 F1mIoU，对物体指向使用 F1@Point，对空间定位以及机器人与 GUI 定位使用任务特定的准确率。

sents.en: We evaluate GroundingPI against 44 baselines on 34 benchmarks spanning 11 perceptual capabilities, covering specialized detectors, general-purpose VLMs, grounding specialists, and embodied foundations.
sents.zh: 我们在涵盖 11 项感知能力的 34 个基准上将 GroundingPI 与 44 个基线进行对比评估，这些基线包括专用检测器、通用 VLM、定位专项模型和具身基础模型。

sents.zh: 所有涉及我们模型的数值结果和结论均基于十次运行的平均值，即使用五个随机种子、每个种子运行两次。

sents.en: Owing to the high computational cost, other baselines that we evaluate locally for the main leaderboard are averaged over three runs, using three random seeds with one run per seed.
sents.zh: 由于计算成本较高，我们在主排行榜上于本地评估的其他基线均基于三次运行的平均值，即使用三个随机种子、每个种子运行一次。

sents.en: GPT-6 Astra is evaluated with thinking effort set to High .
sents.zh: GPT-6 Astra 的评估将思考力度（thinking effort）设置为 High。

sents.en: We use F1mIoU for box grounding and OCR, F1@Point for object pointing, and task-specific accuracy for spatial and robo and GUI grounding.
sents.zh: 我们对边界框定位和 OCR 使用 F1mIoU，对物体指向使用 F1@Point，对空间定位以及机器人与 GUI 定位使用任务特定的准确率。

paragraphs.en: Our evaluation covers common and long-tailed detection on COCO ( Lin et al., 2014 ) and LVIS ( Gupta et al., 2019 ) , and dense and tiny-object detection on Dense200 ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) and VisDrone ( Zhu et al., 2018 ) . Referring grounding uses RefCOCO and RefCOCO+ ( Yu et al., 2016 ) and RefCOCOg ( Mao et al., 2016 ; Nagaraja et al., 2016 ) , together with HumanRef ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) . Spatial and GUI grounding are evaluated on RoboSpatial ( Song et al., 2025 ) , RefSpatial ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) , ScreenSpot-V2 ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , ScreenSpot-Pro ( Li et al., 2025 ) , and OSWorld-G ( Xie et al., 2026 ) . OCR uses HierText ( Long et al., 2022 ) , ICDAR2015 ( Karatzas et al., 2015 ) , TotalText ( Ch’Ng & Chan, 2017 ) , and SROIE ( Huang et al., 2019 ) ; document layout grounding uses DocLayNet ( Pfitzmann et al., 2022 ) and M6Doc ( Cheng et al., 2023 ) . We additionally evaluate exemplar-based visual prompting on FSC147 ( Ranjan et al., 2021 ) and detection benchmarks described above.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的评估涵盖了 COCO（Lin 等，2014）和 LVIS（Gupta 等，2019）上的常见与长尾目标检测，以及 Dense200（Jiang 等，2026）和 VisDrone（Zhu 等，2018）上的密集与微小目标检测。 指称定位使用 RefCOCO、RefCOCO+（Yu 等，2016）和 RefCOCOg（Mao 等，2016；Nagaraja 等，2016），以及 HumanRef（Jiang 等，2025）。 空间定位与 GUI 定位在 RoboSpatial（Song 等，2025）、RefSpatial（Zhou 等，2026）、ScreenSpot-V2（Wu 等，2025）、ScreenSpot-Pro（Li 等，2025）和 OSWorld-G（Xie 等，2026）上进行评估。 OCR 使用 HierText（Long 等，2022）、ICDAR2015（Karatzas 等，2015）、TotalText（Ch'Ng & Chan，2017）和 SROIE（Huang 等，2019）；文档版面定位使用 DocLayNet（Pfitzmann 等，2022）和 M6Doc（Cheng 等，2023）。 我们还在 FSC147（Ranjan 等，2021）及上述检测基准上评估了基于示例的视觉提示。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate autonomous driving on nuScenes ( Caesar et al., 2020 ) and manipulation on RoboTwin 2.0 ( Chen et al., 2025 ) and RoboCasa-GR1 ( Nasiriany et al., 2024 ; NVIDIA et al., 2025 ) . Figure 5 shows lower driving error at every reported horizon and the highest success rate in five of six manipulation settings, including all four OOD settings. These results highlight the value of grounding perception for physical intelligence across distinct action learners and embodiments.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 nuScenes（Caesar et al., 2020）上评估自动驾驶，在 RoboTwin 2.0（Chen et al., 2025）和 RoboCasa-GR1（Nasiriany et al., 2024；NVIDIA et al., 2025）上评估操作任务。 图 5 显示，在所有报告的时间跨度上驾驶误差都更低，并且在六个操作设置中的五个取得了最高的成功率，包括全部四个 OOD 设置。 这些结果凸显了在不同动作学习器与不同本体之间为物理智能提供感知基础的价值。

paragraphs.en: GroundingPI attains an average open-loop L2 error of 0.296 m, improving on Qwen3-VL-4B (0.301 m) and RynnBrain (0.308 m); the trajectory interface and metric are defined in Section 8.1 . This modest, consistent gain suggests that embodied specialization alone need not supply the perception most useful for driving. Reading road signs also motivates accurate and timely OCR in vision-based driving, although this evaluation does not isolate sign reading or measure its latency. For latency-sensitive execution, these results motivate compact perceptual foundations; they do not establish closed-loop performance or a deployment limit for larger models.
paragraphs.zh: GroundingPI 取得平均开环 L2 误差 0.296 米，优于 Qwen3-VL-4B（0.301 米）和 RynnBrain（0.308 米）；轨迹接口与指标的定义见第 8.1 节。 这一适度而稳定的提升表明，仅靠具身专门化未必能提供对驾驶最有用的感知能力。 阅读道路标志也促使基于视觉的驾驶需要准确且及时的 OCR，尽管本评估并未单独隔离标志阅读任务，也未测量其延迟。 对于延迟敏感的执行而言，这些结果支持采用紧凑的感知基础模型；它们并未确立闭环性能，也未给出更大模型的部署上限。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the vision-language and video-generation foundations summarized in Figure 5 , spanning the backbone families used in VLA and WAM systems. To compare their contribution to action learning under controlled downstream conditions, we couple every backbone to the same layer-wise Action DiT. Following the conditioning design of π 0 \pi_{0} ( Black et al., 2024 ) , intermediate features from a single backbone forward pass are projected and resampled to a common interface, then injected into the corresponding cross-attention blocks of the action expert. Within each benchmark, all runs keep the Action DiT architecture, action-training data, optimization budget, action representation, and inference procedure fixed, and vary only the pretrained foundation. This controlled comparison allows us to assess how effectively each foundation supports downstream action learning and how well the resulting policies generalize out of distribution. Section 8.2 provides the implementation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对图 5 中总结的视觉-语言与视频生成基础模型进行评估，涵盖 VLA 与 WAM 系统所使用的主干网络家族。 为了在受控的下游条件下比较各主干网络对动作学习的贡献，我们将每个主干网络都接入相同的分层 Action DiT。 按照 π 0 \pi_{0}（Black et al., 2024）的条件设计，来自单次主干网络前向传播的中间特征被投影并重采样到统一接口，然后注入动作专家中相应的交叉注意力模块。 在每个基准测试中，所有运行都保持 Action DiT 架构、动作训练数据、优化预算、动作表示和推理流程固定，仅改变预训练基础模型。 这种受控比较使我们能够评估每个基础模型对下游动作学习的支持效果，以及由此得到的策略在分布外的泛化能力。 8.2 节提供了具体实现。

paragraphs.en: We report task success rate (SR) across two representative embodiments: fixed-base bimanual tabletop manipulation on RoboTwin2.0 and humanoid dexterous-hand manipulation on RoboCasa-GR1. In-distribution (ID) evaluation follows the full training and evaluation protocol of each benchmark. For out-of-distribution (OOD) evaluation, policies are trained on ID data and tested under held-out conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在两种代表性载体上报告任务成功率（SR）：RoboTwin2.0 上的固定基座双臂桌面操作，以及 RoboCasa-GR1 上的人形灵巧手操作。 分布内（ID）评估遵循每个基准的完整训练与评估协议。 对于分布外（OOD）评估，策略在 ID 数据上训练，并在保留条件下进行测试。

sents.en: In-distribution (ID) evaluation follows the full training and evaluation protocol of each benchmark.
sents.zh: 分布内（ID）评估遵循每个基准的完整训练与评估协议。

sents.en: For out-of-distribution (OOD) evaluation, policies are trained on ID data and tested under held-out conditions.
sents.zh: 对于分布外（OOD）评估，策略在 ID 数据上训练，并在保留条件下进行测试。

paragraphs.en: Fixed-base bimanual — RoboTwin2.0. This widely adopted benchmark spans 50 tabletop manipulation tasks ( Chen et al., 2025 ) . RoboTwin2.0-Full trains and evaluates on both Clean and Randomized data, whereas RoboTwin2.0-Clean2Random trains only on Clean demonstrations and evaluates on Randomized scenes. The released Randomized setting retains the same manipulation tasks but varies scene clutter, lighting, table and background textures, tabletop height, and language instructions. It therefore primarily evaluates scene robustness under environmental variation.
paragraphs.zh: 固定基座双臂 — RoboTwin2.0。 该广泛采用的基准涵盖 50 个桌面操作任务（Chen et al., 2025）。 RoboTwin2.0-Full 在 Clean 和 Randomized 数据上同时进行训练和评估，而 RoboTwin2.0-Clean2Random 仅在 Clean 演示数据上训练，并在 Randomized 场景上评估。 发布的 Randomized 设置保留相同的操作任务，但改变场景杂乱程度、光照、桌面与背景纹理、桌面高度以及语言指令。 因此它主要评估智能体在环境变化下的场景鲁棒性。

sents.zh: 固定基座双臂 — RoboTwin2.0。

paragraphs.en: Humanoid dexterous-hand — RoboCasa-GR1. This benchmark evaluates fine-grained manipulation from head-camera observations without wrist cameras ( Nasiriany et al., 2024 ; NVIDIA et al., 2025 ) . Its full protocol measures ID performance, while OOD evaluation uses three held-out suites ( Chen et al., 2026a ) : Unseen Appearance applies novel textures to familiar object–container pairs; Unseen Combinations places seen objects in novel container pairings; and Unseen Object Types introduces novel object categories. These suites evaluate entity generalization across object appearances, object categories, and object–container combinations.
paragraphs.zh: 人形灵巧手——RoboCasa-GR1。 该基准在没有腕部相机的情况下，从头部位相机观测评估细粒度操作（Nasiriany et al., 2024；NVIDIA et al., 2025）。 其完整协议测量 ID 性能，而 OOD 评估使用三个保留测试套件（Chen et al., 2026a）：Unseen Appearance（未见外观）为熟悉的物体—容器对应用新纹理；Unseen Combinations（未见组合）将见过的物体放入新的容器配对中；Unseen Object Types（未见物体类型）引入新的物体类别。 这些套件评估跨物体外观、物体类别以及物体—容器组合的实体泛化能力。

paragraphs.en: Together, the two protocols evaluate scene robustness and entity generalization, two complementary requirements of an embodied foundation model. Both require stable, task-conditioned perception before action learning, making them direct tests of whether a pretrained foundation provides reusable representations for manipulation.
paragraphs.zh: 这两个协议共同评估场景鲁棒性与实体泛化能力，这是具身基础模型的两个互补需求。 两者都要求在动作学习之前具备稳定的、以任务为条件的感知能力，因此它们能直接检验预训练基础模型是否提供了可复用于操作任务的表征。

paragraphs.en: Under the matched downstream architecture and training protocol, Figure 5 compares backbones with distinct pretraining objectives. We organize the compared backbones into four groups: general-purpose VLMs (Qwen3-VL-4B ( Bai et al., 2025a ) and PaliGemma-3B ( Beyer et al., 2024 ) ), video-generation backbones (Wan2.2-TI2V-5B ( Wan et al., 2025 ) and Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B ( Ali et al., 2025 ) ), grounding models (LocateAnything-3B ( Wang et al., 2026a ) and Rex-Omni-3B ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) ), and embodied foundation models (RynnBrain ( Dang et al., 2026 ) and RynnBrain1.1 ( Li et al., 2026 ) ). Across these heterogeneous pretraining sources, GroundingPI ranks first in five of the six evaluations, including RoboTwin2.0 Full and every OOD setting. It achieves 66.20% on RoboTwin2.0 Full and remains competitive on RoboCasa-GR1 Full at 37.75%, compared with RynnBrain’s 39.00%. These results support precise spatial perception as an effective foundation for action learning across two robot embodiments, with consistent performance under distribution shift.
paragraphs.zh: 在匹配的下游架构与训练协议下，图 5 比较了具有不同预训练目标的主干网络。 我们将所比较的主干网络分为四组：通用视觉语言模型（VLM）（Qwen3-VL-4B（Bai 等，2025a）和 PaliGemma-3B（Beyer 等，2024））、视频生成主干（Wan2.2-TI2V-5B（Wan 等，2025）和 Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B（Ali 等，2025））、定位模型（LocateAnything-3B（Wang 等，2026a）和 Rex-Omni-3B（Jiang 等，2026）），以及具身基础模型（RynnBrain（Dang 等，2026）和 RynnBrain1.1（Li 等，2026））。 在这些异构的预训练来源中，GroundingPI 在六项评估中的五项排名第一，包括 RoboTwin2.0 Full 以及所有分布外（OOD）设置。 它在 RoboTwin2.0 Full 上达到 66.20%，并在 RoboCasa-GR1 Full 上以 37.75% 保持竞争力，相比之下 RynnBrain 为 39.00%。 这些结果表明，精确的空间感知是跨两种机器人本体进行动作学习的有效基础，并且在分布偏移下表现稳定一致。

paragraphs.en: RoboTwin2.0-Clean2Random evaluates scene robustness, while RoboCasa-GR1 evaluates entity generalization across appearances, object types, and object–container relations. GroundingPI ranks first in all four OOD settings. On RoboTwin2.0, it reaches 17.60%, with Rex-Omni second at 14.10%. On RoboCasa-GR1, RynnBrain ranks second across Type, Appearance, and Container OOD. Rex-Omni’s strength in scene robustness is consistent with its emphasis on detection, referring, and coordinate prediction ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) . RynnBrain’s strength in entity generalization is consistent with its broader language-conditioned embodied and semantic understanding, including spatiotemporal localization and physically grounded reasoning ( Dang et al., 2026 ) . These observations highlight the complementary strengths of precise perceptual grounding and broader embodied semantic understanding.
paragraphs.zh: RoboTwin2.0-Clean2Random 评估场景鲁棒性，而 RoboCasa-GR1 评估跨外观、物体类型以及物体–容器关系的实体泛化能力。 GroundingPI 在全部四种 OOD 设置中均排名第一。 在 RoboTwin2.0 上，它达到 17.60%，Rex-Omni 以 14.10% 位列第二。 在 RoboCasa-GR1 上，RynnBrain 在 Type、Appearance 和 Container 三种 OOD 设置中均排名第二。 Rex-Omni 在场景鲁棒性方面的优势与其对检测、指代和坐标预测的侧重相一致（ Jiang et al., 2026 ）。 RynnBrain 在实体泛化方面的优势与其更广泛的基于语言条件的具身与语义理解能力相一致，包括时空定位和基于物理的推理（ Dang et al., 2026 ）。 这些观察凸显了精确感知定位与更广泛具身语义理解之间的互补优势。

paragraphs.en: Figure 6 illustrates a conceptual progression from action-only adaptation of general VLMs, through perceptual supervision in the π \pi family, to grounding as a native foundation capability ( Black et al., 2024 ; Intelligence et al., 2025 ; Driess et al., 2025 ) . GroundingPI retains broad VQA-style, language-conditioned semantic knowledge while emphasizing precise spatial perception through grounding and pointing supervision. Visual primitives provide an interface for physical prompting, specifying targets, locations, and structures alongside language. Together with precise spatial perception, this interface supports scene robustness and entity generalization. Our transfer results evaluate the pretrained foundation for physical intelligence rather than a separate prompting intervention. The data-composition ablation in Section 5.3.2 further examines which forms of grounding supervision transfer to action.
paragraphs.zh: 图 6 展示了一条概念上的演进路径：从对通用视觉语言模型（VLM）仅进行动作适配，到 π \pi 系列中的感知监督，再到将视觉落地（grounding）作为原生的基础能力（Black et al., 2024; Intelligence et al., 2025; Driess et al., 2025）。 GroundingPI 在保留广泛 VQA 风格、语言条件化语义知识的同时，通过落地（grounding）与指向（pointing）监督强调精确的空间感知。 视觉基元提供了一个物理提示（physical prompting）的接口，可与语言一同指定目标、位置和结构。 与精确的空间感知相结合，该接口支持场景鲁棒性和实体泛化。 我们的迁移结果评估的是面向物理智能的预训练基础能力，而非一种独立的提示干预手段。 第 5.3.2 节中的数据构成消融实验进一步考察了哪些形式的落地（grounding）监督能够迁移到动作上。

sents.en: Figure 6 illustrates a conceptual progression from action-only adaptation of general VLMs, through perceptual supervision in the π \pi family, to grounding as a native foundation capability ( Black et al., 2024 ; Intelligence et al., 2025 ; Driess et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 图 6 展示了一条概念上的演进路径：从对通用视觉语言模型（VLM）仅进行动作适配，到 π \pi 系列中的感知监督，再到将视觉落地（grounding）作为原生的基础能力（Black et al., 2024; Intelligence et al., 2025; Driess et al., 2025）。

sents.zh: 视觉基元提供了一个物理提示（physical prompting）的接口，可与语言一同指定目标、位置和结构。

sents.en: Together with precise spatial perception, this interface supports scene robustness and entity generalization.
sents.zh: 与精确的空间感知相结合，该接口支持场景鲁棒性和实体泛化。

sents.en: Our transfer results evaluate the pretrained foundation for physical intelligence rather than a separate prompting intervention.
sents.zh: 我们的迁移结果评估的是面向物理智能的预训练基础能力，而非一种独立的提示干预手段。

sents.en: The data-composition ablation in Section 5.3.2 further examines which forms of grounding supervision transfer to action.

paragraphs.en: Figure 7 evaluates data efficiency under the RoboCasa-GR1 Full/ID protocol using 25%, 50%, 75%, and 100% of the robot demonstrations. We vary only the amount of action data, keeping the architecture, action-learning approach, and other training choices unchanged. GroundingPI leads all three reduced-data settings. At 50% data, its 28.75% SR exceeds every baseline at 75%, where RynnBrain achieves the highest score of 27.75%.
paragraphs.zh: 图 7 在 RoboCasa-GR1 Full/ID 协议下，使用 25%、50%、75% 和 100% 的机器人演示数据评估了数据效率。 我们仅改变动作数据的数量，保持架构、动作学习方法和其他训练选择不变。 GroundingPI 在所有三种数据减少的设置中均领先。 在 50% 数据时，其 28.75% 的成功率（SR）超过了所有基线在 75% 数据时的表现，其中 RynnBrain 取得了 27.75% 的最高分。

sents.en: Figure 7 evaluates data efficiency under the RoboCasa-GR1 Full/ID protocol using 25%, 50%, 75%, and 100% of the robot demonstrations.
sents.zh: 图 7 在 RoboCasa-GR1 Full/ID 协议下，使用 25%、50%、75% 和 100% 的机器人演示数据评估了数据效率。

sents.en: We vary only the amount of action data, keeping the architecture, action-learning approach, and other training choices unchanged.
sents.zh: 我们仅改变动作数据的数量，保持架构、动作学习方法和其他训练选择不变。

sents.en: GroundingPI leads all three reduced-data settings.
sents.zh: GroundingPI 在所有三种数据减少的设置中均领先。

sents.en: At 50% data, its 28.75% SR exceeds every baseline at 75%, where RynnBrain achieves the highest score of 27.75%.
sents.zh: 在 50% 数据时，其 28.75% 的成功率（SR）超过了所有基线在 75% 数据时的表现，其中 RynnBrain 取得了 27.75% 的最高分。

paragraphs.en: These results support prioritizing precise spatial perception before action learning. The same physical-prompting interface allows scarce action demonstrations to focus on control rather than relearning basic perception. Together with the preceding results, this suggests that precise grounding supports effective and generalizable action learning as well as more data-efficient adaptation.
paragraphs.zh: 这些结果支持在动作学习之前优先实现精确的空间感知。 同一物理提示接口使得稀缺的动作演示能够专注于控制，而无需重新学习基础感知。 结合前述结果，这表明精确的接地不仅支持有效且可泛化的动作学习，还支持更高效的数据适应。

sents.en: These results support prioritizing precise spatial perception before action learning.
sents.zh: 这些结果支持在动作学习之前优先实现精确的空间感知。

paragraphs.en: Figure 8 tracks the aggregate grounding score together with manipulation success on the RoboCasa-GR1 ID and OOD splits as pretraining grows from 88.4B to 221B tokens. This scaling sweep examines how perception and downstream action learning evolve together.
paragraphs.zh: 图 8 展示了当预训练从 88.4B 增长到 221B token 时，RoboCasa-GR1 分布内（ID）与分布外（OOD）划分上的总体接地得分与操作成功率的变化情况。 这项规模扩展实验考察了感知与下游动作学习如何共同演进。

sents.en: Figure 8 tracks the aggregate grounding score together with manipulation success on the RoboCasa-GR1 ID and OOD splits as pretraining grows from 88.4B to 221B tokens.
sents.zh: 图 8 展示了当预训练从 88.4B 增长到 221B token 时，RoboCasa-GR1 分布内（ID）与分布外（OOD）划分上的总体接地得分与操作成功率的变化情况。

sents.en: This scaling sweep examines how perception and downstream action learning evolve together.
sents.zh: 这项规模扩展实验考察了感知与下游动作学习如何共同演进。

paragraphs.en: As pretraining scale increases, the grounding score rises steadily and robotic manipulation performance improves on both splits. Scaling grounding pretraining therefore strengthens precise perception and transfers to more effective and generalizable action learning.
paragraphs.zh: 随着预训练规模的扩大，接地分数稳步上升，且在两个划分上机器人操控性能均有提升。 因此，扩展接地预训练能够强化精确感知，并迁移到更有效、更具泛化能力的动作学习中。

sents.en: As pretraining scale increases, the grounding score rises steadily and robotic manipulation performance improves on both splits.
sents.zh: 随着预训练规模的扩大，接地分数稳步上升，且在两个划分上机器人操控性能均有提升。

sents.en: Scaling grounding pretraining therefore strengthens precise perception and transfers to more effective and generalizable action learning.
sents.zh: 因此，扩展接地预训练能够强化精确感知，并迁移到更有效、更具泛化能力的动作学习中。

paragraphs.en: The curves move together across the scaling trajectory, with generalization tracking grounding quality most closely. This correspondence links the two observations: better grounding provides a stronger perceptual foundation for downstream action learning.
paragraphs.zh: 在整个扩展轨迹中，各条曲线同步变化，其中泛化与接地质量的贴合度最高。 这一对应关系将两个观察联系起来：更好的接地为下游动作学习提供了更坚实的感知基础。

paragraphs.en: The scaling study in Section 5.3.1 establishes that more grounding pretraining improves downstream action learning. We now ask what that data should contain. Figure 9 decomposes the training mixture into basic and dense grounding, referring, pointing, and auxiliary OCR, layout, and GUI supervision.
paragraphs.zh: 第5.3.1节的扩展性研究确立了更多的接地预训练能改进下游动作学习。 我们现在要问的是这些数据应当包含什么内容。 图9将训练混合数据分解为基础接地与密集接地、指代、指向，以及辅助的OCR、版面和GUI监督。

paragraphs.en: In the available leave-one-out comparisons, removing dense grounding degrades both manipulation splits and nuScenes performance more than removing referring or robo pointing. In driving and manipulation, relevant targets may be densely packed or small relative to the image, coupling dense and tiny-object perception through a shared need for fine-grained spatial discrimination. Dense multi-object supervision therefore provides the core precise spatial perception that transfers across downstream domains.
paragraphs.zh: 在现有的留一对比实验中，移除密集定位比移除指代或机器人指向对两个操作数据集分割以及 nuScenes 性能的损害更大。 在驾驶与操作任务中，相关目标可能密集分布或相对于图像较小，这使得密集感知与微小目标感知通过共同的细粒度空间辨别需求而相互耦合。 因此，密集多目标监督提供了可跨下游领域迁移的核心精确空间感知能力。

paragraphs.en: Removing the OCR-containing group causes the largest manipulation losses on both splits (5.33/3.63 pp), yet this group alone transfers poorly. We hypothesize that OCR catalyzes perceptual learning: sharp character boundaries demand local precision, while transcription binds visual regions to semantics, providing a localized captioning proxy task for vision–language alignment. Such supervision could strengthen fine-grained ViT features and amplify the benefits of dense spatial supervision for grounding and downstream action learning. Additional OCR mixing experiments favor combining cold-start and batch-level supervision for manipulation transfer; the OCR-specific mechanism remains a hypothesis ( Section 9.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 移除含 OCR 的数据组在两个划分上都会造成最大的操作性能损失（5.33/3.63 个百分点），但仅靠这一组数据本身的迁移效果却较差。 我们假设 OCR 能催化感知学习：清晰的字符边界要求局部精确性，而转录任务则将视觉区域与语义绑定，为视觉—语言对齐提供了一个局部化的描述生成代理任务。 这类监督可以强化 ViT 的细粒度特征，并放大密集空间监督对定位和下游动作学习带来的收益。 额外的 OCR 混合实验支持将冷启动与批级监督相结合以促进操作任务迁移；OCR 的具体作用机制仍属假设（第 9.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: No reduced mixture matches the full mixture simultaneously across manipulation performance and nuScenes localization. Dense grounding supplies the spatial core, auxiliary perception sharpens the visual representation, and referring and pointing connect that representation to language and action-relevant targets. Together with the scaling study, these results show that scale determines how much grounding capability is learned, while composition determines whether it forms an effective and generalizable interface for action learning.
paragraphs.zh: 没有任何缩减混合模型能在操作性能和 nuScenes 定位上同时与完整混合模型相匹配。 密集定位提供空间核心，辅助感知锐化视觉表征，而指代与指向则将该表征与语言及与动作相关的目标连接起来。 结合扩展性研究，这些结果表明，规模决定了能学到多少定位能力，而组成方式则决定了它能否为动作学习形成一个有效且可泛化的接口。

paragraphs.en: The backbone comparisons suggest possible sensitivities beyond supervision. RynnBrain1.1 trails RynnBrain in all six manipulation settings despite improving driving. Its Qwen3.5 base combines Gated DeltaNet with gated attention, whereas RynnBrain uses Qwen3-VL ( Li et al., 2026 ; Dang et al., 2026 ; Qwen Team, 2026a ) . Recurrent compression and output gating may affect access to spatial features under a new action objective; Section 10.2 derives conditional memory and gradient effects ( Yang et al., 2025b ; Qiu et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 骨干网络的对比表明，监督之外可能还存在其他敏感性因素。 RynnBrain1.1 尽管在驾驶方面有所提升，但在全部六个操作设置中均落后于 RynnBrain。 它的 Qwen3.5 基座将 Gated DeltaNet 与门控注意力相结合，而 RynnBrain 使用的是 Qwen3-VL（Li et al., 2026；Dang et al., 2026；Qwen Team, 2026a）。 循环压缩与输出门控可能会在新的动作目标下影响对空间特征的访问；第 10.2 节推导了条件记忆与梯度效应（Yang et al., 2025b；Qiu et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: DeepStack enriches visual evidence through intermediate feature injection, but may also increase the demands of aligning several feature levels with an action readout ( Bai et al., 2025a ; Meng et al., 2024 ) . GroundingPI instead couples MoonViT-V2 to a full-attention Qwen3-4B decoder through a single visual interface. Since RynnBrain and Qwen3-VL both use DeepStack, their driving difference cannot isolate this mechanism ( Section 10.3 ). The older Qwen2.5-VL foundations of Rex-Omni and LocateAnything also leave base-model quality as a possible factor. These comparisons motivate controlled studies of feature accessibility and alignment; they do not establish architectural causes of the observed rankings.
paragraphs.zh: DeepStack 通过中间特征注入来增强视觉证据，但也可能增加将多个特征层级与动作读出对齐的要求（Bai et al., 2025a；Meng et al., 2024）。 GroundingPI 则通过单一视觉接口将 MoonViT-V2 与全注意力的 Qwen3-4B 解码器耦合。 由于 RynnBrain 和 Qwen3-VL 都使用 DeepStack，二者的驱动差异无法隔离这一机制（第 10.3 节）。 Rex-Omni 和 LocateAnything 较旧的 Qwen2.5-VL 基座也使基础模型质量成为可能的影响因素。 这些对比启发了对特征可访问性与对齐的受控研究；它们并不能确立所观察到的排名的架构性成因。

paragraphs.en: From first principles, a useful starting point is what spatial information the visual input can actually determine. An image records projected structure, while its absolute metric scale may remain ambiguous. Human perception illustrates this limitation: we may readily identify and localize a distant object yet struggle to judge whether it is 25 m or 30 m away. A raw L 1 L_{1} depth loss nevertheless assigns a 5 m error, which need not reflect the perceptual difficulty; a fixed metric tolerance also has different implications for close-range manipulation and distant scenes. Under perspective projection, small image-space errors can further translate into larger metric depth and 3D localization errors at longer ranges. These considerations motivate a hypothesis: grounding may help elicit and develop spatial intelligence in VLMs by forcing spatial understanding to become explicit through precise localization . Predicting boxes and points ties language to specific visual regions, providing low-level supervision that may compel the model to preserve and use fine-grained spatial evidence. Relative depth, such as scene-normalized values in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , could offer complementary supervision of depth ordering and scene structure without requiring absolute scale. We therefore conjecture that prioritizing these visually grounded targets may better cultivate transferable perception, with metric calibration learned for downstream action. This is a hypothesis about perceptual pretraining, and the proposed advantage over absolute metric supervision remains untested in our study.
paragraphs.zh: 从第一性原理出发，一个有用的切入点是考察视觉输入究竟能够确定哪些空间信息。 图像记录的是投影后的结构，而其绝对度量尺度可能保持模糊。 人类感知正好说明了这一局限：我们可以轻松地识别并定位一个远处的物体，却难以判断它究竟是 25 米还是 30 米远。 然而，原始的 L 1 L_{1} 深度损失会给出 5 米的误差，这未必反映感知上的困难；固定的度量容差对近距离操作和远距离场景而言，含义也不相同。 在透视投影下，图像空间中微小的误差还会在更远的距离上转化为更大的度量深度误差和三维定位误差。 这些考量引出了一个假设：通过精确的定位迫使空间理解变得显式，视觉定位或许有助于在视觉语言模型（VLM）中激发并发展空间智能。 预测边界框和点将语言与特定的视觉区域绑定，提供了低层监督，可能促使模型保留并利用细粒度的空间证据。 相对深度，例如 [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] 中的场景归一化数值，则可以在不需要绝对尺度的情况下，对深度排序和场景结构提供互补的监督。 因此我们推测，优先采用这些视觉接地的目标可能更有利于培养可迁移的感知能力，而度量校准则可以在下游动作中学习得到。 这是一个关于感知预训练的假设，其相对于绝对度量监督的优势在本研究中尚未经过检验。

paragraphs.en: A useful distinction may be between deliberative planning (System 2) and fast perception–action execution (System 1), as explored in dual-system robotics ( NVIDIA et al., 2025 ; Bu et al., 2025 ) . Planning can benefit from extensive knowledge, coding, and long-horizon reasoning; execution requires timely feedback, precise interaction perception, and reliable control. The analogy to coding agents is functional: sophisticated reasoning has limited practical value when generated programs repeatedly fail to run, just as strong planning can be constrained by unreliable physical execution.
paragraphs.zh: 一个有用的区分可能是深思式规划（系统 2）与快速感知—动作执行（系统 1），如双系统机器人学中所探讨的（NVIDIA et al., 2025；Bu et al., 2025）。 规划可以受益于广博的知识、编程能力和长时程推理；执行则需要及时反馈、精确的交互感知和可靠的控制。 与编程智能体的类比是功能性的：当生成的程序反复无法运行时，精巧的推理其实用价值有限；同样，强大的规划也可能受制于不可靠的物理执行。

paragraphs.en: General VLMs, including Qwen and the PaliGemma base of π 0 \pi_{0} ( Bai et al., 2025a ; Black et al., 2024 ) , offer valuable starting points, but may not best serve every execution role. GroundingPI explores a perception-native alternative: learning where to interact before limited action data teach how to act . Astra provides a frontier reference for grounding quality; comparison with it probes the perceptual frontier rather than its suitability for direct VLA adaptation. Such frontier models may instead serve higher-level planning roles. Our results motivate stronger perceptual foundations for System 1; a deployed dual-system controller and its latency remain to be evaluated ( Section 10.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 通用VLM（包括Qwen以及π 0 \pi_{0}的PaliGemma基座模型（Bai et al., 2025a；Black et al., 2024））提供了有价值的起点，但未必能最好地服务于每一个执行角色。 GroundingPI探索了一种以感知为先的替代路径：在有限动作数据教智能体如何行动之前，先学习在哪里进行交互。 Astra为定位质量提供了前沿参照；与它的比较旨在探测感知边界，而非评估其是否适合直接进行VLA适配。 此类前沿模型或许更适合承担更高层的规划角色。 我们的结果为System 1奠定更强的感知基础提供了依据；已部署的双系统控制器及其延迟仍有待评估（见第10.4节）。

sents.en: General VLMs, including Qwen and the PaliGemma base of π 0 \pi_{0} ( Bai et al., 2025a ; Black et al., 2024 ) , offer valuable starting points, but may not best serve every execution role.
sents.zh: 通用VLM（包括Qwen以及π 0 \pi_{0}的PaliGemma基座模型（Bai et al., 2025a；Black et al., 2024））提供了有价值的起点，但未必能最好地服务于每一个执行角色。

sents.en: GroundingPI explores a perception-native alternative: learning where to interact before limited action data teach how to act .
sents.zh: GroundingPI探索了一种以感知为先的替代路径：在有限动作数据教智能体如何行动之前，先学习在哪里进行交互。

sents.en: Astra provides a frontier reference for grounding quality; comparison with it probes the perceptual frontier rather than its suitability for direct VLA adaptation.
sents.zh: Astra为定位质量提供了前沿参照；与它的比较旨在探测感知边界，而非评估其是否适合直接进行VLA适配。

sents.en: Such frontier models may instead serve higher-level planning roles.
sents.zh: 此类前沿模型或许更适合承担更高层的规划角色。

sents.en: Our results motivate stronger perceptual foundations for System 1; a deployed dual-system controller and its latency remain to be evaluated ( Section 10.4 ).
sents.zh: 我们的结果为System 1奠定更强的感知基础提供了依据；已部署的双系统控制器及其延迟仍有待评估（见第10.4节）。

paragraphs.en: We introduced GroundingPI, a 4B-parameter grounding foundation model for broad and precise perception. Across 34 grounding benchmarks, it outperforms similarly sized models and remains competitive with GPT-6 Astra, while transferring effectively to driving and manipulation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 GroundingPI，一个具有 40 亿参数的接地基础模型，能够实现广泛而精确的感知。 在 34 个接地基准测试中，它超越了同等规模的模型，并与 GPT-6 Astra 保持竞争力，同时能有效地迁移到驾驶与操作任务中。

sents.en: We introduced GroundingPI, a 4B-parameter grounding foundation model for broad and precise perception.
sents.zh: 我们提出了 GroundingPI，一个具有 40 亿参数的接地基础模型，能够实现广泛而精确的感知。

sents.en: Across 34 grounding benchmarks, it outperforms similarly sized models and remains competitive with GPT-6 Astra, while transferring effectively to driving and manipulation.
sents.zh: 在 34 个接地基准测试中，它超越了同等规模的模型，并与 GPT-6 Astra 保持竞争力，同时能有效地迁移到驾驶与操作任务中。

paragraphs.en: Reliable physical interaction requires connecting instructions to precise spatial targets, a capability that general semantic understanding alone does not guarantee and scarce action supervision may not adequately develop. Dedicated grounding pretraining directly addresses this perceptual gap, supporting better manipulation generalization and action-data efficiency. Our analyses highlight basic grounding as an important foundation, dense grounding as valuable for physical interaction, and OCR as a potential catalyst for perceptual learning. These findings motivate distinct embodied foundations: broad reasoning for System 2 planning, and precise perception for reliable System 1 execution, the direction explored by GroundingPI.
paragraphs.zh: 可靠的物理交互需要将指令与精确的空间目标相连接，这一能力仅靠通用语义理解无法保证，而稀缺的动作监督也可能不足以充分培养。 专门的接地预训练直接弥补了这一感知差距，有助于提升操作泛化能力和动作数据的利用效率。 我们的分析表明，基础接地是一项重要基础，稠密接地对物理交互很有价值，而 OCR 则可能是感知学习的催化剂。 这些发现指向了不同的具身基础：面向 System 2 规划的广泛推理能力，以及面向可靠 System 1 执行的精确感知能力，这正是 GroundingPI 所探索的方向。

paragraphs.en: This work does not involve human-subject studies. All grounding datasets and evaluation benchmarks used in this work were obtained from publicly available or appropriately licensed sources in accordance with their respective terms and licenses. Driving was evaluated offline on nuScenes, and robot manipulation in simulation; no real-world vehicles or robots were deployed in these experiments. GroundingPI is developed as a general-purpose visual grounding foundation model for research, with downstream experiments intended to study how precise spatial perception transfers to physical-intelligence tasks rather than to demonstrate real-world autonomous deployment. We encourage appropriate safety evaluation and human oversight before applying such models to real-world embodied systems. The authors declare no conflicts of interest.
paragraphs.zh: 本工作不涉及人类受试者研究。 本工作使用的所有接地数据集与评估基准均来自公开可用或经过适当许可的来源，并符合其各自的条款与许可证。 驾驶任务在 nuScenes 上离线评估，机器人操作在仿真中评估；这些实验中未部署真实世界的车辆或机器人。 GroundingPI 作为面向研究的通用视觉接地基础模型开发，下游实验旨在研究精确的空间感知如何迁移到物理智能任务，而非展示真实世界的自主部署。 我们鼓励在将此类模型应用于真实世界的具身系统之前进行适当的安全评估与人类监督。 作者声明不存在利益冲突。

paragraphs.en: We will publicly release the code, model weights, and evaluation data for GroundingPI to support systematic and reproducible evaluation. The release will include training configurations and evaluation scripts with standardized task prompts, output parsers, and metric implementations. The input/output protocol, coordinate conventions, architecture, tokenizer, and visual processing are detailed in Sections 7.1 and 7.2 ; data construction and validation in Section 7.3 ; and base-model training, spatial supervised fine-tuning, and optimization hyperparameters in Section 7.4 . Downstream interfaces, the shared action architecture, matched training budgets, and driving and manipulation evaluation protocols are specified in Sections 8.1 and 8.2 . Data-efficiency, scaling, training-mixture, and OCR-mixing studies are documented in Sections 9.1 , 9.2 , 9.3 and 9.4 . The benchmark suite, evaluation metrics, reporting conventions, and complete grounding results are provided in Section 12 , including the visual-prompting evaluations in Section 12.9 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们将公开发布 GroundingPI 的代码、模型权重和评估数据，以支持系统化、可复现的评估。 发布内容将包括训练配置和评估脚本，其中包含标准化的任务提示词、输出解析器和指标实现。 输入/输出协议、坐标约定、架构、分词器和视觉处理详见第 7.1 节和第 7.2 节；数据构建与验证见第 7.3 节；基座模型训练、空间监督微调和优化超参数见第 7.4 节。 下游接口、共享动作架构、匹配的训练预算以及驾驶和操作评估协议见第 8.1 节和第 8.2 节。 数据效率、扩展性、训练混合比例和 OCR 混合研究记录于第 9.1、9.2、9.3 和 9.4 节。 基准测试套件、评估指标、报告规范和完整的定位（grounding）结果见第 12 节，其中包括第 12.9 节中的视觉提示评估。

paragraphs.en: GroundingPI uses the same language-conditioned interface for box and point prediction. A query specifies the task and its semantic targets; the response associates each label, referring expression, or OCR transcription with a geometric payload. The examples below illustrate the protocol rather than training records. Displayed line breaks are for readability and are omitted in the serialized response.
paragraphs.zh: GroundingPI 使用相同的语言条件接口进行框和点预测。 查询指定任务及其语义目标；响应将每个标签、指代表达或 OCR 转写文本与几何负载相关联。 以下示例仅用于说明协议，而非训练记录。 为便于阅读而显示的换行符在序列化响应中会被省略。

sents.en: GroundingPI uses the same language-conditioned interface for box and point prediction.
sents.zh: GroundingPI 使用相同的语言条件接口进行框和点预测。

sents.en: A query specifies the task and its semantic targets; the response associates each label, referring expression, or OCR transcription with a geometric payload.
sents.zh: 查询指定任务及其语义目标；响应将每个标签、指代表达或 OCR 转写文本与几何负载相关联。

sents.en: The examples below illustrate the protocol rather than training records.
sents.zh: 以下示例仅用于说明协议，而非训练记录。

sents.en: Displayed line breaks are for readability and are omitted in the serialized response.

paragraphs.en: <|object_ref_start|> label <|object_ref_end|> <|box_start|> payload <|box_end|>
paragraphs.zh: <|object_ref_start|> 标签 <|object_ref_end|> <|box_start|> 载荷 <|box_end|>

paragraphs.en: A box uses four consecutive coordinate tokens in x ​ y ​ x ​ y xyxy order; a point uses two in ( x , y ) (x,y) order. Multiple instances with the same label share one wrapper, with tuples separated by commas without spaces. Distinct entries are separated by a comma and a space. Explicitly queried but absent categories retain their label and use the ordinary text payload None .
paragraphs.zh: 边框使用四个按 x y x y 顺序排列的连续坐标标记；点使用两个按 (x, y) 顺序排列的坐标标记。 具有相同标签的多个实例共用一个包装器，各元组之间用不带空格的逗号分隔。 不同的条目之间用逗号加空格分隔。 被明确查询但不存在的类别保留其标签，并使用普通文本载荷 None。

paragraphs.en: Table 7 lists the canonical user prompts. Category names are joined by </c> without additional spaces or commas; requested category strings are preserved in grounding and layout responses. Referring prompts provide the target description, and OCR responses use recognized text as their labels. Dense and ordinary grounding share a prompt. Visual prompts encode example boxes with the same coordinate vocabulary as the output. The image and user prompt are supplied through the native multimodal chat template.
paragraphs.zh: 表 7 列出了规范的用户提示词。 类别名称通过 </c> 连接，不添加额外的空格或逗号；请求的类别字符串在定位（grounding）和布局（layout）响应中保持原样。 指代型提示词提供目标描述，OCR 响应使用识别出的文本作为其标签。 密集定位与普通定位共用一个提示词。 视觉提示词使用与输出相同的坐标词表对示例框进行编码。 图像和用户提示词通过原生的多模态聊天模板提供。

paragraphs.en: Image coordinates are normalized relative to image width and height. An integer coordinate v v on the intermediate [ 0 , 1000 ] [0,1000] grid is mapped to q ⁡ ( v ) = ⌊ ( 999 ​ v + 500 ) / 1000 ⌋ q(v)=\lfloor(999v+500)/1000\rfloor and encoded by the corresponding atomic coordinate token. Image-space coordinates are recovered by multiplying q / 999 q/999 by the corresponding image dimension. Source x ​ y ​ w ​ h xywh boxes are converted to x ​ y ​ x ​ y xyxy before normalization, and polygon annotations are converted to their axis-aligned enclosing boxes. Point targets follow their task definition; box centers are used only where the annotation convention specifies them. Non-finite, out-of-range, inverted, or degenerate geometry is rejected rather than silently repaired.
paragraphs.zh: 图像坐标相对于图像宽度和高度进行归一化。 中间 [0,1000] 网格上的整数坐标 v 映射为 q(v)=⌊(999v+500)/1000⌋，并由相应的原子坐标词元进行编码。 图像空间坐标通过将 q/999 乘以相应的图像维度来恢复。 源 xywh 边界框在归一化之前先转换为 xyxy 格式，多边形标注则转换为其轴对齐的外接框。 点目标遵循其任务定义；框中心仅在标注规范指定时使用。 非有限、超出范围、反转或退化的几何数据会被拒绝，而不是被静默修复。

sents.zh: 非有限、超出范围、反转或退化的几何数据会被拒绝，而不是被静默修复。

paragraphs.en: Within a label, box instances are stably sorted by x 1 x_{1} and unordered points by x x ; ordered trajectories retain temporal order, including repeated locations. Trajectories use a separate metric-coordinate convention described in Section 8.1 . The marker <|box_end|> closes one payload, whereas <|im_end|> ends the response. Structural and coordinate tokens identify the entries and their geometry.
paragraphs.zh: 在同一个标签内，框实例按 x_{1} 稳定排序，无序点按 x 排序；有序轨迹保持时间顺序，包括重复的位置。 轨迹使用第 8.1 节中描述的单独的度量坐标约定。 标记 <|box_end|> 结束一个负载，而 <|im_end|> 结束整个响应。 结构与坐标标记用于标识各个条目及其几何信息。

paragraphs.en: GroundingPI combines a MoonViT-V2 (Kimi K3) visual encoder, a learnable multimodal projector, and a Qwen3-4B language backbone. Visual embeddings are inserted into the language sequence, which uses one-dimensional rotary position indices. All 36 language layers use full attention. Table 8 summarizes the architecture.
paragraphs.zh: GroundingPI 结合了 MoonViT-V2（Kimi K3）视觉编码器、可学习的多模态投影器和 Qwen3-4B 语言主干。 视觉嵌入被插入到语言序列中，该序列使用一维旋转位置索引。 全部 36 个语言层均使用完全注意力。 表 8 总结了该架构。

sents.en: GroundingPI combines a MoonViT-V2 (Kimi K3) visual encoder, a learnable multimodal projector, and a Qwen3-4B language backbone.
sents.zh: GroundingPI 结合了 MoonViT-V2（Kimi K3）视觉编码器、可学习的多模态投影器和 Qwen3-4B 语言主干。

sents.en: Visual embeddings are inserted into the language sequence, which uses one-dimensional rotary position indices.
sents.zh: 视觉嵌入被插入到语言序列中，该序列使用一维旋转位置索引。

sents.en: All 36 language layers use full attention.
sents.zh: 全部 36 个语言层均使用完全注意力。

sents.en: Table 8 summarizes the architecture.
sents.zh: 表 8 总结了该架构。

paragraphs.en: Module Parameters Vision encoder 401,214,464 Projector 27,267,584 Decoder excluding vocabulary matrices 3,633,511,936 Input embedding 390,835,200 Output head 390,835,200 Total 4,843,664,384

The tokenizer extends the 151,669-entry base vocabulary with 1,000 coordinate tokens and </c> , giving 152,670 entries. Coordinate IDs are 151669–152668, and the category separator has ID 152669. EOS and padding are distinct (151645 and 151643). The input embedding and output head are untied; all semantic, structural, and coordinate tokens are predicted by the same vocabulary head. The complete multimodal model contains approximately 4.844B parameters, including the visual encoder and vocabulary matrices ( Table 9 ); Qwen3-4B denotes the language-backbone family.
paragraphs.zh: 分词器在151,669个词条的基础词表上扩展了1,000个坐标标记和</c>，共得到152,670个词条。 坐标ID为151669–152668，类别分隔符的ID为152669。 EOS与填充（padding）是不同的（分别为151645和151643）。 输入嵌入与输出头不共享权重；所有语义、结构和坐标标记都由同一个词表输出头进行预测。 完整的多模态模型包含约48.44亿（4.844B）个参数，包括视觉编码器和词表矩阵（表9）；Qwen3-4B表示语言主干模型系列。

paragraphs.en: The engine combines complementary predictions for object localization, segmentation, text recognition, GUI elements, and document regions. For category-level grounding, category discovery precedes category-conditioned localization. Candidate instances are mapped to the original image and aligned within a common query scope and annotation granularity. Fusion operates separately on semantic and geometric fields: verified information is retained, while disagreements trigger additional evidence for the affected fields. Object–part containment and word–line relations are preserved rather than merged as duplicates.
paragraphs.zh: 该引擎组合了针对物体定位、分割、文本识别、GUI 元素和文档区域的互补预测。 对于类别级定位，类别发现先于类别条件化的定位。 候选实例被映射回原图，并在统一的查询范围和标注粒度内进行对齐。 融合分别在语义域和几何域上进行：经验证的信息被保留，而不一致之处则触发对受影响域的额外证据获取。 物体与部件的包含关系以及单词与文本行的关系被保留下来，而不是作为重复项被合并。

sents.en: The engine combines complementary predictions for object localization, segmentation, text recognition, GUI elements, and document regions.
sents.zh: 该引擎组合了针对物体定位、分割、文本识别、GUI 元素和文档区域的互补预测。

sents.en: For category-level grounding, category discovery precedes category-conditioned localization.
sents.zh: 对于类别级定位，类别发现先于类别条件化的定位。

sents.en: Candidate instances are mapped to the original image and aligned within a common query scope and annotation granularity.
sents.zh: 候选实例被映射回原图，并在统一的查询范围和标注粒度内进行对齐。

sents.en: Fusion operates separately on semantic and geometric fields: verified information is retained, while disagreements trigger additional evidence for the affected fields.
sents.zh: 融合分别在语义域和几何域上进行：经验证的信息被保留，而不一致之处则触发对受影响域的额外证据获取。

sents.en: Object–part containment and word–line relations are preserved rather than merged as duplicates.
sents.zh: 物体与部件的包含关系以及单词与文本行的关系被保留下来，而不是作为重复项被合并。

paragraphs.en: Each field is marked as accepted, rejected, or unresolved. Validation checks geometry, syntax, semantic correspondence, and consistency with available evidence. Required fields are determined by the query, independently of which fields a teacher produces; missing required fields remain unresolved. A supervision item is accepted only when all required fields are accepted. Queries requiring all instances additionally require a coverage check over the relevant region. For an absent-target answer, absence is itself a required fact to verify; an empty prediction does not establish it. Consequently, an unresolved instance can block an all-target or counting query while leaving independently verified local supervision usable. Multi-teacher agreement supports validation but does not guarantee annotation correctness.
paragraphs.zh: 每个字段被标记为接受、拒绝或未决。 验证会检查几何、语法、语义对应关系，以及与可用证据的一致性。 必需字段由查询决定，与教师产出哪些字段无关；缺失的必需字段保持未决状态。 只有当所有必需字段都被接受时，一个监督项才会被接受。 要求覆盖所有实例的查询还需要对相关区域进行覆盖检查。 对于目标缺席的答案，缺席本身就是一个需要验证的必需事实；空预测并不能确立这一点。 因此，一个未决的实例可能会阻塞全目标查询或计数查询，同时使已独立验证的局部监督仍然可用。 多教师的一致性可以支持验证，但并不能保证标注的正确性。

sents.zh: 因此，一个未决的实例可能会阻塞全目标查询或计数查询，同时使已独立验证的局部监督仍然可用。

sents.en: Multi-teacher agreement supports validation but does not guarantee annotation correctness.
sents.zh: 多教师的一致性可以支持验证，但并不能保证标注的正确性。

paragraphs.en: Accepted annotations train a unified grounding expert, whose subsequent predictions pass through the same fusion and validation procedure. Complementary teachers and local observations are invoked when semantic identity, geometry, or coverage remains unresolved. Crop predictions are mapped back to the original coordinates; supervision requiring detail unavailable in the original training input retains the necessary local view. Additional evidence can both add annotations and revise existing labels. Revisions propagate to dependent tasks, and invalidated labels are withdrawn until their dependencies are resolved.
paragraphs.zh: 已接受的标注用于训练一个统一的定位专家，其后续预测会经过相同的融合与验证流程。 当语义身份、几何或覆盖范围仍未确定时，会调用互补的教师与局部观测。 裁剪预测会被映射回原始坐标；需要原始训练输入中不具备的细节的监督会保留必要的局部视图。 附加证据既可以添加标注，也可以修改现有标签。 修改会传播到依赖任务，且被判定无效的标签会被撤回，直到其依赖关系得到解决。

sents.zh: 已接受的标注用于训练一个统一的定位专家，其后续预测会经过相同的融合与验证流程。

sents.zh: 当语义身份、几何或覆盖范围仍未确定时，会调用互补的教师与局部观测。

sents.zh: 附加证据既可以添加标注，也可以修改现有标签。
