sents.zh: 修改会传播到依赖任务，且被判定无效的标签会被撤回，直到其依赖关系得到解决。

paragraphs.en: A verified instance record can support several tasks: category–box pairs provide grounding, attributes and relations support referring, valid instance regions support pointing, exemplar correspondence supports visual prompting, and text regions paired with transcriptions support OCR. Each derived query retains its own required fields and coverage conditions. This reuse preserves task-specific semantics while sharing the underlying visual evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 经验证的实例记录可以支持多项任务：类别—边界框对提供定位，属性与关系支持指代，有效实例区域支持指向，样本对应关系支持视觉提示，文本区域与转录文本配对支持光学字符识别（OCR）。 每个派生查询保留各自必需的字段和覆盖条件。 这种复用在共享底层视觉证据的同时，保留了任务特定的语义。

sents.en: A verified instance record can support several tasks: category–box pairs provide grounding, attributes and relations support referring, valid instance regions support pointing, exemplar correspondence supports visual prompting, and text regions paired with transcriptions support OCR.
sents.zh: 经验证的实例记录可以支持多项任务：类别—边界框对提供定位，属性与关系支持指代，有效实例区域支持指向，样本对应关系支持视觉提示，文本区域与转录文本配对支持光学字符识别（OCR）。

sents.en: Each derived query retains its own required fields and coverage conditions.
sents.zh: 每个派生查询保留各自必需的字段和覆盖条件。

sents.en: This reuse preserves task-specific semantics while sharing the underlying visual evidence.
sents.zh: 这种复用在共享底层视觉证据的同时，保留了任务特定的语义。

paragraphs.en: GroundingPI training comprises three successive phases: (i) Base VLM training (Pretrain 1), (ii) coordinate alignment (Pretrain 2), also termed supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and (iii) reinforcement learning (RL) with GRPO. Pretrain 1 contains Stages 1–3 below, while Pretrain 2 corresponds to Stage 4. Thus, Stage 1–4 numbering describes the supervised training recipe within the first two phases. Each stage starts from the preceding checkpoint, and RL follows the Stage 4 SFT checkpoint. The aggregate training exposure is 500.41 ​ B + 221.17 ​ B 500.41\mathrm{B}+221.17\mathrm{B} tokens.
paragraphs.zh: GroundingPI 的训练包含三个相继的阶段：(i) 基础 VLM 训练（Pretrain 1），(ii) 坐标对齐（Pretrain 2），也称监督微调（SFT），以及 (iii) 使用 GRPO 的强化学习（RL）。 Pretrain 1 包含下文的阶段 1–3，而 Pretrain 2 对应阶段 4。 因此，阶段 1–4 的编号描述的是前两个阶段内的监督训练方案。 每个阶段都从前一个检查点开始，RL 则在阶段 4 的 SFT 检查点之后进行。 总训练量为 500.41 B + 221.17 B 个词元。

sents.en: GroundingPI training comprises three successive phases: (i) Base VLM training (Pretrain 1), (ii) coordinate alignment (Pretrain 2), also termed supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and (iii) reinforcement learning (RL) with GRPO.
sents.zh: GroundingPI 的训练包含三个相继的阶段：(i) 基础 VLM 训练（Pretrain 1），(ii) 坐标对齐（Pretrain 2），也称监督微调（SFT），以及 (iii) 使用 GRPO 的强化学习（RL）。

sents.en: Pretrain 1 contains Stages 1–3 below, while Pretrain 2 corresponds to Stage 4.
sents.zh: Pretrain 1 包含下文的阶段 1–3，而 Pretrain 2 对应阶段 4。

sents.en: Thus, Stage 1–4 numbering describes the supervised training recipe within the first two phases.
sents.zh: 因此，阶段 1–4 的编号描述的是前两个阶段内的监督训练方案。

sents.en: Each stage starts from the preceding checkpoint, and RL follows the Stage 4 SFT checkpoint.
sents.zh: 每个阶段都从前一个检查点开始，RL 则在阶段 4 的 SFT 检查点之后进行。

sents.en: The aggregate training exposure is 500.41 ​ B + 221.17 ​ B 500.41\mathrm{B}+221.17\mathrm{B} tokens.
sents.zh: 总训练量为 500.41 B + 221.17 B 个词元。

paragraphs.en: We freeze the visual encoder and language model and update only the projector using image-caption supervision. Causal cross-entropy on the assistant response aligns visual features with the language input space, without an additional feature-distance or contrastive objective. The context and packing lengths are both 8192 tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 我们冻结视觉编码器和语言模型，仅使用图像-描述监督来更新投影器。 对助手回复进行因果交叉熵，即可将视觉特征与语言输入空间对齐，无需额外的特征距离或对比目标。 上下文长度和打包长度均为 8192 个词元。

sents.en: We freeze the visual encoder and language model and update only the projector using image-caption supervision.
sents.zh: 我们冻结视觉编码器和语言模型，仅使用图像-描述监督来更新投影器。

sents.en: Causal cross-entropy on the assistant response aligns visual features with the language input space, without an additional feature-distance or contrastive objective.
sents.zh: 对助手回复进行因果交叉熵，即可将视觉特征与语言输入空间对齐，无需额外的特征距离或对比目标。

sents.en: The context and packing lengths are both 8192 tokens.
sents.zh: 上下文长度和打包长度均为 8192 个词元。

paragraphs.en: We unfreeze the visual encoder, projector, and language model and jointly train on text-only and general image–text data. Text examples provide full-token causal supervision, while multimodal examples supervise assistant responses. The language model uses a peak learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} , and the visual encoder and projector each use 10 − 6 10^{-6} . The context and packing lengths remain 8192 tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 我们解冻视觉编码器、投影器和语言模型，并在纯文本数据与通用图文数据上进行联合训练。 文本样本提供全 token 的因果监督，而多模态样本对助手回复进行监督。 语言模型使用峰值学习率 10 − 5 10^{-5}，视觉编码器和投影器各自使用 10 − 6 10^{-6}。 上下文长度和打包长度保持为 8192 个 token。

sents.en: We unfreeze the visual encoder, projector, and language model and jointly train on text-only and general image–text data.
sents.zh: 我们解冻视觉编码器、投影器和语言模型，并在纯文本数据与通用图文数据上进行联合训练。

sents.en: Text examples provide full-token causal supervision, while multimodal examples supervise assistant responses.
sents.zh: 文本样本提供全 token 的因果监督，而多模态样本对助手回复进行监督。

sents.en: The language model uses a peak learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} , and the visual encoder and projector each use 10 − 6 10^{-6} .
sents.zh: 语言模型使用峰值学习率 10 − 5 10^{-5}，视觉编码器和投影器各自使用 10 − 6 10^{-6}。

sents.en: The context and packing lengths remain 8192 tokens.
sents.zh: 上下文长度和打包长度保持为 8192 个 token。

paragraphs.en: We continue updating all modules on general visual question answering and instruction-following data, image captions, and videos. The context and packing lengths increase to 32768 tokens to accommodate longer multimodal sequences. This stage does not separately mix in the spatial-specialization data or an independent text-only quota; image-caption supervision remains part of the general visual training mixture.
paragraphs.zh: 我们继续在通用视觉问答与指令遵循数据、图像描述以及视频上更新所有模块。 上下文与打包长度增加到 32768 个 token，以容纳更长的多模态序列。 该阶段不会单独混入空间特化数据或独立的纯文本配额；图像描述监督仍然是通用视觉训练混合数据的一部分。

sents.en: We continue updating all modules on general visual question answering and instruction-following data, image captions, and videos.
sents.zh: 我们继续在通用视觉问答与指令遵循数据、图像描述以及视频上更新所有模块。

sents.en: The context and packing lengths increase to 32768 tokens to accommodate longer multimodal sequences.
sents.zh: 上下文与打包长度增加到 32768 个 token，以容纳更长的多模态序列。

sents.en: This stage does not separately mix in the spatial-specialization data or an independent text-only quota; image-caption supervision remains part of the general visual training mixture.
sents.zh: 该阶段不会单独混入空间特化数据或独立的纯文本配额；图像描述监督仍然是通用视觉训练混合数据的一部分。

paragraphs.en: Starting from the Stage 3 checkpoint, coordinate alignment updates all modules using eight spatial task groups: detection, GUI grounding, referring-expression grounding, referring-expression pointing, OCR, document layout, dense pointing and counting, and visual prompting. This phase is the SFT phase described in the main text. It uses an 8192-token context and packing length and applies autoregressive supervision to semantic labels, box and point coordinates, and protocol markers. Quantized coordinate tokens share the same cross-entropy objective as other valid response tokens; no additional IoU regression loss is introduced.
paragraphs.zh: 从阶段3检查点出发，坐标对齐使用八个空间任务组来更新所有模块：检测、GUI定位、指代表达定位、指代表达指向、OCR、文档版面、密集指向与计数，以及视觉提示。 该阶段即正文所述的SFT阶段。 它使用8192个词元的上下文与打包长度，并对语义标签、框与点坐标以及协议标记施加自回归监督。 量化坐标词元与其他有效响应词元共享同一交叉熵目标；未引入额外的IoU回归损失。

sents.en: Starting from the Stage 3 checkpoint, coordinate alignment updates all modules using eight spatial task groups: detection, GUI grounding, referring-expression grounding, referring-expression pointing, OCR, document layout, dense pointing and counting, and visual prompting.
sents.zh: 从阶段3检查点出发，坐标对齐使用八个空间任务组来更新所有模块：检测、GUI定位、指代表达定位、指代表达指向、OCR、文档版面、密集指向与计数，以及视觉提示。

sents.en: This phase is the SFT phase described in the main text.
sents.zh: 该阶段即正文所述的SFT阶段。

sents.en: It uses an 8192-token context and packing length and applies autoregressive supervision to semantic labels, box and point coordinates, and protocol markers.
sents.zh: 它使用8192个词元的上下文与打包长度，并对语义标签、框与点坐标以及协议标记施加自回归监督。

sents.en: Quantized coordinate tokens share the same cross-entropy objective as other valid response tokens; no additional IoU regression loss is introduced.
sents.zh: 量化坐标词元与其他有效响应词元共享同一交叉熵目标；未引入额外的IoU回归损失。

paragraphs.en: Stages 1–4 use causal next-token prediction. Let 𝒮 d \mathcal{S}_{d} contain valid sample–position pairs ( b , t ) (b,t) in domain d ∈ { text , vlm } d\in\{\mathrm{text},\mathrm{vlm}\} . The domain loss is ℒ d = − ( max ( | 𝒮 d | , 1 ) ) − 1 ∑ ( b , t ) ∈ 𝒮 d log p θ ( z b , t ∣ V b , z b , < t ) \mathcal{L}_{d}=-\bigl(\max(|\mathcal{S}_{d}|,1)\bigr)^{-1}\sum_{(b,t)\in\mathcal{S}_{d}}\log p_{\theta}(z_{b,t}\allowbreak\mid V_{b},z_{b,<t}) , with V b = ∅ V_{b}=\varnothing for text-only examples. Text supervision covers valid causal targets; multimodal supervision covers assistant responses, excluding prompt, visual, padding, and empty thinking-prefix positions. In Stage 4, this assistant-only loss includes the semantic, coordinate, and protocol tokens of structured spatial responses. Packing preserves each sample’s causal boundaries and supervision mask.

sents.en: Stages 1–4 use causal next-token prediction.
sents.zh: 阶段 1–4 使用因果的下一词元预测。

sents.en: Let 𝒮 d \mathcal{S}_{d} contain valid sample–position pairs ( b , t ) (b,t) in domain d ∈ { text , vlm } d\in\{\mathrm{text},\mathrm{vlm}\} .
sents.zh: 设 𝒮_d \mathcal{S}_{d} 包含域 d ∈ {text, vlm} d\in\{\mathrm{text},\mathrm{vlm}\} 中有效的样本–位置对 (b,t) (b,t)。

sents.en: The domain loss is ℒ d = − ( max ( | 𝒮 d | , 1 ) ) − 1 ∑ ( b , t ) ∈ 𝒮 d log p θ ( z b , t ∣ V b , z b , < t ) \mathcal{L}_{d}=-\bigl(\max(|\mathcal{S}_{d}|,1)\bigr)^{-1}\sum_{(b,t)\in\mathcal{S}_{d}}\log p_{\theta}(z_{b,t}\allowbreak\mid V_{b},z_{b,<t}) , with V b = ∅ V_{b}=\varnothing for text-only examples.
sents.zh: 域损失为 ℒ_d = −(max(|𝒮_d|, 1))⁻¹ ∑_{(b,t)∈𝒮_d} log p_θ(z_{b,t} | V_b, z_{b,<t}) \mathcal{L}_{d}=-\bigl(\max(|\mathcal{S}_{d}|,1)\bigr)^{-1}\sum_{(b,t)\in\mathcal{S}_{d}}\log p_{\theta}(z_{b,t}\mid V_{b},z_{b,<t})，其中对纯文本样本有 V_b = ∅ V_{b}=\varnothing。

sents.en: Text supervision covers valid causal targets; multimodal supervision covers assistant responses, excluding prompt, visual, padding, and empty thinking-prefix positions.
sents.zh: 文本监督覆盖有效的因果目标；多模态监督覆盖智能体的回复，排除提示词、视觉、填充以及空的思考前缀位置。

sents.en: Stage 2 minimizes ℒ text + ℒ vlm \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{text}}+\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{vlm}} , with each domain normalized over its valid targets across data-parallel workers.

sents.en: Packing preserves each sample’s causal boundaries and supervision mask.
sents.zh: 打包保留了每个样本的因果边界和监督掩码。

paragraphs.en: Table 10 summarizes the configuration for Pretrain 1 and Pretrain 2. The supervised training recipe uses 128 GPUs, BF16 precision, ZeRO-1, FlashAttention, and activation recomputation. Only the projector is trainable in Stage 1; Stages 2–4 update all modules. Language parameters include the input embedding and untied output head. All four stages use one gradient-accumulation step, AdamW with betas ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) (0.9,0.95) and ϵ = 10 − 8 \epsilon=10^{-8} , and gradient clipping at 1.0. Weight decay is zero in Stage 1 and 0.1 thereafter. Cosine schedules use 3% warmup and decay to 2% of the peak learning rate in Stage 1 and 10% in Stages 2–4. The configured budget is one epoch per stage. Global batches count packed sequences; context length is the complete multimodal sequence budget, distinct from the visual budget of 1024 projected tokens. Seed and data seed are both 42.
paragraphs.zh: 表10总结了Pretrain 1和Pretrain 2的配置。 有监督训练方案使用128块GPU、BF16精度、ZeRO-1、FlashAttention以及激活重计算。 第一阶段仅投影器可训练；第二至第四阶段更新所有模块。 语言参数包括输入嵌入和未绑定的输出头。 全部四个阶段均使用一步梯度累积、betas为 (0.9, 0.95) 且 \epsilon=10^{-8} 的AdamW，以及1.0的梯度裁剪。 权重衰减在第一阶段为零，其后为0.1。 余弦调度使用3%的预热，并在第一阶段衰减至峰值学习率的2%，在第二至第四阶段衰减至10%。 配置的预算为每阶段一个epoch。 全局批次按打包序列计算；上下文长度是完整的多模态序列预算，区别于1024个投影token的视觉预算。 随机种子和数据种子均为42。

sents.en: Table 10 summarizes the configuration for Pretrain 1 and Pretrain 2.
sents.zh: 表10总结了Pretrain 1和Pretrain 2的配置。

sents.en: The supervised training recipe uses 128 GPUs, BF16 precision, ZeRO-1, FlashAttention, and activation recomputation.
sents.zh: 有监督训练方案使用128块GPU、BF16精度、ZeRO-1、FlashAttention以及激活重计算。

sents.zh: 第一阶段仅投影器可训练；第二至第四阶段更新所有模块。

sents.en: Language parameters include the input embedding and untied output head.
sents.zh: 语言参数包括输入嵌入和未绑定的输出头。

sents.en: All four stages use one gradient-accumulation step, AdamW with betas ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) (0.9,0.95) and ϵ = 10 − 8 \epsilon=10^{-8} , and gradient clipping at 1.0.
sents.zh: 全部四个阶段均使用一步梯度累积、betas为 (0.9, 0.95) 且 \epsilon=10^{-8} 的AdamW，以及1.0的梯度裁剪。

sents.en: The configured budget is one epoch per stage.

sents.zh: 随机种子和数据种子均为42。

paragraphs.en: RL is the third overall training phase. We initialize the policy from the coordinate-aligned Pretrain 2 / SFT checkpoint and optimize complete generated outputs with task-specific GRPO rewards.
paragraphs.zh: 强化学习是第三个整体训练阶段。 我们从坐标对齐的 Pretrain 2 / SFT 检查点初始化策略，并使用任务特定的 GRPO 奖励优化完整生成的输出。

sents.en: RL is the third overall training phase.
sents.zh: 强化学习是第三个整体训练阶段。

sents.en: We initialize the policy from the coordinate-aligned Pretrain 2 / SFT checkpoint and optimize complete generated outputs with task-specific GRPO rewards.

paragraphs.en: Following GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) , the sampled KL penalty is d i , t = ρ i , t − log ⁡ ρ i , t − 1 ≥ 0 d_{i,t}=\rho_{i,t}-\log\rho_{i,t}-1\geq 0 , where ρ i , t = π ref ​ ( y i , t ∣ c i , t ) / π θ ​ ( y i , t ∣ c i , t ) \rho_{i,t}=\pi_{\mathrm{ref}}(y_{i,t}\allowbreak\mid c_{i,t})/\pi_{\theta}(y_{i,t}\allowbreak\mid c_{i,t}) . Its expectation equals D KL ( π θ ∥ π ref ) D_{\mathrm{KL}}(\pi_{\theta}\|\pi_{\mathrm{ref}}) when the token is sampled from π θ \pi_{\theta} ; evaluated on old-policy rollouts, it is a sampled regularizer rather than an unbiased current-policy KL estimate. We use a frozen copy of the Pretrain 2 / SFT checkpoint as the reference, ϵ = 0.2 \epsilon=0.2 , and β = 0.02 \beta=0.02 . Advantages and the old/reference policies are held fixed during the policy update. Only nonpadding response positions contribute to the objective. The vision encoder and projector remain frozen throughout reinforcement post-training.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循 GRPO（Shao et al., 2024），采样的 KL 惩罚为 d i , t = ρ i , t − log ⁡ ρ i , t − 1 ≥ 0 d_{i,t}=\rho_{i,t}-\log\rho_{i,t}-1\geq 0 ，其中 ρ i , t = π ref ​ ( y i , t ∣ c i , t ) / π θ ​ ( y i , t ∣ c i , t ) \rho_{i,t}=\pi_{\mathrm{ref}}(y_{i,t}\allowbreak\mid c_{i,t})/\pi_{\theta}(y_{i,t}\allowbreak\mid c_{i,t}) 。 当该词元从 π θ \pi_{\theta} 采样时，其期望等于 D KL ( π θ ∥ π ref ) D_{\mathrm{KL}}(\pi_{\theta}\|\pi_{\mathrm{ref}}) ；在旧策略回放 rollout 上评估时，它是一个采样型正则项，而非对当前策略 KL 的无偏估计。 我们使用 Pretrain 2 / SFT 检查点的冻结副本作为参考模型，ϵ = 0.2 \epsilon=0.2 ，β = 0.02 \beta=0.02 。 在策略更新过程中，优势以及旧策略/参考策略保持固定。 只有非填充的响应位置对目标函数有贡献。 在整个强化后训练过程中，视觉编码器和投影器保持冻结。

paragraphs.en: The complementary reward is a weighted sum of the components in Table 12 , clipped to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . Its detection term is F ¯ = ( F 0.50 + F 0.75 + F 0.95 ) / 3 \overline{F}=(F_{0.50}+F_{0.75}+F_{0.95})/3 , where F τ F_{\tau} is detection F1 at IoU threshold τ \tau ; the matched-box IoU term provides continuous localization feedback. Format, count, and ordering scores assess the structured response, while nonnegative duplicate and oversized-box penalties discourage redundant or imprecise predictions. These auxiliary scores are distinct from the OCR count and format terms below. Both grounding components are standardized separately before their weighted combination, as described in Section 7.6 .

Define I i ​ j = IoU ⁡ ( b i , b ^ j ) I_{ij}=\operatorname{IoU}(b_{i},\hat{b}_{j}) . Text normalization 𝒩 \mathcal{N} applies Unicode NFKC, case folding, and alphanumeric filtering; symbol-only strings retain distinct Unicode-based keys. For nonempty normalized transcriptions, edit similarity is E i ​ j = 1 − Lev ⁡ ( 𝒩 ⁡ ( s i ) , 𝒩 ⁡ ( s ^ j ) ) / max ⁡ ( | 𝒩 ⁡ ( s i ) | , | 𝒩 ⁡ ( s ^ j ) | ) E_{ij}=1-\operatorname{Lev}(\mathcal{N}(s_{i}),\mathcal{N}(\hat{s}_{j}))/\max(|\mathcal{N}(s_{i})|,|\mathcal{N}(\hat{s}_{j})|) . paragraphs.en: The driving task uses the current front-camera image and up to seven ego-state records at 0.5-second intervals, including the current state and covering at most three seconds of history. Historical positions are expressed relative to the current ego pose, together with available velocity, acceleration, and steering information. Short histories retain their observed length; missing states are not replaced by fabricated zeros. The output is six cumulative future positions over three seconds, Y = ( ( x 1 , y 1 ) , … , ( x 6 , y 6 ) ) Y=((x_{1},y_{1}),\ldots,(x_{6},y_{6})) , with x x forward and y y left, measured in meters. Current visual observations and historical states condition the prediction; future waypoints are the supervised targets.
paragraphs.zh: 驾驶任务使用当前前视相机图像以及以 0.5 秒为间隔的最多七条自车状态记录，包括当前状态，并覆盖最多三秒的历史。 历史位置以相对当前自车位姿的方式表示，同时包含可用的速度、加速度和转向信息。 较短的历史保留其观测到的长度；缺失的状态不会用伪造的零值来替代。 输出是三秒内的六个累积未来位置，Y = ( ( x 1 , y 1 ) , … , ( x 6 , y 6 ) ) Y=((x_{1},y_{1}),\ldots,(x_{6},y_{6}))，其中 x x 为前方，y y 为左侧，单位为米。 当前视觉观测和历史状态作为预测的条件；未来路径点为监督目标。

paragraphs.en: The manipulation study compares the foundations used by vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action model (WAM) systems without allowing their native action heads, conditioning paths, or optimization budgets to become additional variables. We replace the model-specific control modules with the same backbone-to-action interface and the same fixed-capacity action expert. The evaluated variable is therefore the pretrained foundation that supplies the representation for action learning.
paragraphs.zh: 操控研究比较了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）系统与世界-动作模型（WAM）系统所使用的基础模型，同时不允许其原生的动作头、条件输入路径或优化预算成为额外的变量。 我们用相同的「主干到动作」接口和相同的固定容量动作专家替换了各模型专用的控制模块。 因此，被评估的变量是为动作学习提供表示的预训练基础模型。

sents.en: The manipulation study compares the foundations used by vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action model (WAM) systems without allowing their native action heads, conditioning paths, or optimization budgets to become additional variables.
sents.zh: 操控研究比较了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）系统与世界-动作模型（WAM）系统所使用的基础模型，同时不允许其原生的动作头、条件输入路径或优化预算成为额外的变量。

sents.en: We replace the model-specific control modules with the same backbone-to-action interface and the same fixed-capacity action expert.
sents.zh: 我们用相同的「主干到动作」接口和相同的固定容量动作专家替换了各模型专用的控制模块。

sents.en: The evaluated variable is therefore the pretrained foundation that supplies the representation for action learning.
sents.zh: 因此，被评估的变量是为动作学习提供表示的预训练基础模型。

paragraphs.en: The compared foundations are Qwen3-VL-4B ( Bai et al., 2025a ) and PaliGemma-3B ( Beyer et al., 2024 ) ; Wan2.2-TI2V-5B ( Wan et al., 2025 ) and Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B ( Ali et al., 2025 ) ; LocateAnything-3B ( Wang et al., 2026a ) and Rex-Omni-3B ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) ; and RynnBrain-2B ( Dang et al., 2026 ) and RynnBrain1.1-2B ( Li et al., 2026 ) , alongside GroundingPI. These groups characterize the pretrained foundations rather than different downstream action heads.
paragraphs.zh: 所比较的基础模型分别是 Qwen3-VL-4B（Bai et al., 2025a）与 PaliGemma-3B（Beyer et al., 2024）；Wan2.2-TI2V-5B（Wan et al., 2025）与 Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B（Ali et al., 2025）；LocateAnything-3B（Wang et al., 2026a）与 Rex-Omni-3B（Jiang et al., 2026）；以及 RynnBrain-2B（Dang et al., 2026）与 RynnBrain1.1-2B（Li et al., 2026），并与 GroundingPI 一同对比。 这些分组刻画的是预训练基础模型，而非不同的下游动作头。

sents.en: The compared foundations are Qwen3-VL-4B ( Bai et al., 2025a ) and PaliGemma-3B ( Beyer et al., 2024 ) ; Wan2.2-TI2V-5B ( Wan et al., 2025 ) and Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B ( Ali et al., 2025 ) ; LocateAnything-3B ( Wang et al., 2026a ) and Rex-Omni-3B ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) ; and RynnBrain-2B ( Dang et al., 2026 ) and RynnBrain1.1-2B ( Li et al., 2026 ) , alongside GroundingPI.
sents.zh: 所比较的基础模型分别是 Qwen3-VL-4B（Bai et al., 2025a）与 PaliGemma-3B（Beyer et al., 2024）；Wan2.2-TI2V-5B（Wan et al., 2025）与 Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B（Ali et al., 2025）；LocateAnything-3B（Wang et al., 2026a）与 Rex-Omni-3B（Jiang et al., 2026）；以及 RynnBrain-2B（Dang et al., 2026）与 RynnBrain1.1-2B（Li et al., 2026），并与 GroundingPI 一同对比。

sents.en: These groups characterize the pretrained foundations rather than different downstream action heads.
sents.zh: 这些分组刻画的是预训练基础模型，而非不同的下游动作头。

paragraphs.en: For each observation and language instruction, the foundation backbone is executed once. Given a backbone with N B N_{B} transformer blocks, we sample eight hidden states at normalized depths ℓ j = round ⁡ ( j ⁡ ( N B − 1 ) / 7 ) \ell_{j}=\operatorname{round}(j(N_{B}-1)/7) for j ∈ { 0 , … , 7 } j\in\{0,\ldots,7\} . This rule preserves comparable relative depths across foundations with different numbers of layers and avoids selecting backbone-specific layers. Each sampled state H ℓ j H_{\ell_{j}} is normalized, mapped from the backbone width D B D_{B} to the common action width by a backbone-specific linear projector, augmented with a learned depth embedding, and compressed by a shared learned-query resampler: Z j = LN ⁡ ( H ℓ j ) ​ W B + e j Z_{j}=\operatorname{LN}(H_{\ell_{j}})W_{B}+e_{j} and C j = Resampler 64 ⁡ ( Z j ) C_{j}=\operatorname{Resampler}_{64}(Z_{j}) . The projector W B W_{B} is shared across the eight depths of a backbone, and the same resampler is shared across both depths and models. Every cross-attention block consequently receives the same number and width of condition tokens, independent of the backbone’s native width or token count.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每次观测和语言指令，基础主干网络只需执行一次。 给定一个包含 N B N_{B} 个 transformer 块的主干网络，我们在归一化深度 ℓ j = round ⁡ ( j ⁡ ( N B − 1 ) / 7 ) \ell_{j}=\operatorname{round}(j(N_{B}-1)/7) 处采样八个隐藏状态，其中 j ∈ { 0 , … , 7 } j\in\{0,\ldots,7\} 。 该规则在层数不同的基础模型之间保持了可比较的相对深度，并避免选择特定于主干网络的层。 每个采样状态 H ℓ j H_{\ell_{j}} 先被归一化，再通过一个特定于主干网络的线性投影器从主干宽度 D B D_{B} 映射到统一动作宽度，加上一个可学习的深度嵌入，并由一个共享的可学习查询重采样器进行压缩： Z j = LN ⁡ ( H ℓ j ) ​ W B + e j Z_{j}=\operatorname{LN}(H_{\ell_{j}})W_{B}+e_{j} 以及 C j = Resampler 64 ⁡ ( Z j ) C_{j}=\operatorname{Resampler}_{64}(Z_{j}) 。 投影器 W B W_{B} 在一个主干网络的八个深度之间共享，同一个重采样器则在所有深度和所有模型之间共享。 因此，每个交叉注意力块都接收相同数量和宽度的条件 token，而不依赖于主干网络的原生宽度或 token 数量。

sents.en: For each observation and language instruction, the foundation backbone is executed once.
sents.zh: 对于每次观测和语言指令，基础主干网络只需执行一次。

sents.en: Given a backbone with N B N_{B} transformer blocks, we sample eight hidden states at normalized depths ℓ j = round ⁡ ( j ⁡ ( N B − 1 ) / 7 ) \ell_{j}=\operatorname{round}(j(N_{B}-1)/7) for j ∈ { 0 , … , 7 } j\in\{0,\ldots,7\} .
sents.zh: 给定一个包含 N B N_{B} 个 transformer 块的主干网络，我们在归一化深度 ℓ j = round ⁡ ( j ⁡ ( N B − 1 ) / 7 ) \ell_{j}=\operatorname{round}(j(N_{B}-1)/7) 处采样八个隐藏状态，其中 j ∈ { 0 , … , 7 } j\in\{0,\ldots,7\} 。

sents.en: This rule preserves comparable relative depths across foundations with different numbers of layers and avoids selecting backbone-specific layers.
sents.zh: 该规则在层数不同的基础模型之间保持了可比较的相对深度，并避免选择特定于主干网络的层。

sents.en: Each sampled state H ℓ j H_{\ell_{j}} is normalized, mapped from the backbone width D B D_{B} to the common action width by a backbone-specific linear projector, augmented with a learned depth embedding, and compressed by a shared learned-query resampler: Z j = LN ⁡ ( H ℓ j ) ​ W B + e j Z_{j}=\operatorname{LN}(H_{\ell_{j}})W_{B}+e_{j} and C j = Resampler 64 ⁡ ( Z j ) C_{j}=\operatorname{Resampler}_{64}(Z_{j}) .
sents.zh: 每个采样状态 H ℓ j H_{\ell_{j}} 先被归一化，再通过一个特定于主干网络的线性投影器从主干宽度 D B D_{B} 映射到统一动作宽度，加上一个可学习的深度嵌入，并由一个共享的可学习查询重采样器进行压缩： Z j = LN ⁡ ( H ℓ j ) ​ W B + e j Z_{j}=\operatorname{LN}(H_{\ell_{j}})W_{B}+e_{j} 以及 C j = Resampler 64 ⁡ ( Z j ) C_{j}=\operatorname{Resampler}_{64}(Z_{j}) 。

sents.en: The projector W B W_{B} is shared across the eight depths of a backbone, and the same resampler is shared across both depths and models.
sents.zh: 投影器 W B W_{B} 在一个主干网络的八个深度之间共享，同一个重采样器则在所有深度和所有模型之间共享。

sents.en: Every cross-attention block consequently receives the same number and width of condition tokens, independent of the backbone’s native width or token count.
sents.zh: 因此，每个交叉注意力块都接收相同数量和宽度的条件 token，而不依赖于主干网络的原生宽度或 token 数量。

paragraphs.en: For VLA foundations, the eight states are taken from the language-conditioned vision–language stack. For WAM foundations, they are taken from the video-generation backbone under a fixed feature-extraction state, including the observed-frame construction, diffusion timestep, condition mask, noise realization, input resolution, and number of frames. In both cases, a single backbone forward pass produces all eight conditions, which are cached and reused throughout action denoising. We remove any model-specific raw-text or proprioceptive cross-attention bypass: language, perception, and dynamics information can reach the action expert only through the evaluated foundation representations. Thus, the two paradigms differ in the pretrained foundation that constructs the physical representation, while sharing the same downstream control architecture and compute schedule.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 VLA 基础模型，八个状态取自语言条件化的视觉–语言堆栈。 对于 WAM 基础模型，这些状态取自视频生成主干在固定特征提取状态下的输出，包括观测帧构建、扩散时间步、条件掩码、噪声实现、输入分辨率和帧数。 在两种情况下，单次主干前向传播即可产生全部八个条件，这些条件会被缓存并在整个动作去噪过程中复用。 我们移除任何模型特定的原始文本或本体感觉交叉注意力旁路：语言、感知和动力学信息只能通过被评估的基础模型表征到达动作专家。 因此，两种范式在构建物理表征的预训练基础模型上有所不同，同时共享相同的下游控制架构与计算调度。

paragraphs.en: The common action expert is a fixed-depth, fixed-width π \pi -style ( Black et al., 2024 ) Action DiT ( Peebles & Xie, 2023 ) trained with flow matching ( Lipman et al., 2023 ) . It contains 16 atomic transformer blocks, alternating between layer-wise cross-attention and action self-attention. Blocks 0 , 2 , … , 14 0,2,\ldots,14 attend to C 0 , C 1 , … , C 7 C_{0},C_{1},\ldots,C_{7} , respectively, and blocks 1 , 3 , … , 15 1,3,\ldots,15 perform self-attention over the action-side sequence. paragraphs.en: This protocol fixes the quantities most likely to confound a backbone comparison: action-head depth and width, condition-token budget, state and action paths, action data, batch size, number of updates, optimizer and schedule, flow objective, and inference computation. Backbone-specific width projectors are the only interface parameters whose size varies with the native backbone width; they are shared across depth and remain small relative to the common action expert. The comparison therefore measures how effectively the representations inherited from VLA- and WAM-style foundations support effective and generalizable action learning under matched downstream capacity and supervision.
paragraphs.zh: 本协议固定了最可能干扰骨干网络比较的各变量：动作头深度与宽度、条件 token 预算、状态与动作路径、动作数据、批大小、更新次数、优化器与调度、流目标，以及推理计算。 针对特定骨干网络的宽度投影器是唯一随骨干网络原生宽度而改变规模的接口参数；它们在不同深度间共享，且相对于公共动作专家而言规模很小。 因此，该比较衡量的是：在匹配的下游容量与监督条件下，继承自 VLA 式和 WAM 式基础的表征能在多大程度上有效支持有效且可泛化的动作学习。

paragraphs.en: The distinction between learning where to interact and how to act interprets this result in terms of the paper’s motivation. A reusable perceptual foundation may let downstream supervision focus more on control, but the experiment does not separately measure perceptual and motor-learning sample complexity. It also does not vary physical prompts. The evidence concerns downstream demonstration efficiency in manipulation; it does not establish lower total pretraining cost, a universal data-scaling law, or driving-data efficiency.
paragraphs.zh: 区分「在哪里交互的学习」与「如何行动的学习」，可以从本文的动机出发来解读这一结果。 可复用的感知基础或许能让下游监督更专注于控制，但该实验并未分别测量感知学习与运动学习的样本复杂度。 它也没有改变物理提示。 相关证据涉及操作任务中下游示范的效率；它并未证明更低的预训练总成本、普适的数据缩放规律，或驾驶数据的效率提升。

paragraphs.en: Table 16: Performance at successive grounding-training exposures. The last row is the full configuration. Exposure order Grounding Avg RoboCasa-GR1 ID SR RoboCasa-GR1 OOD Avg SR 1 61.69 33.92 26.59 2 69.71 35.92 30.00 3 72.22 38.75 32.06 4 (full) 73.68 37.75 33.38 The endpoint gains are 11.99 pp in grounding, 3.83 pp in ID SR, and 6.78 pp in OOD Avg SR, using the recorded values before rounding. Grounding and OOD performance improve at every step, whereas ID SR falls by 1.00 pp at the final step. paragraphs.en: Adding A and D to F raises ID SR from 24.42% to 30.92%, OOD Avg SR from 7.28% to 29.28%, and reduces driving error from 0.391 to 0.310 m. This supports the importance of basic object localization together with pointing, particularly for generalization. Since A and D change jointly and no A-only leave-one-out row is available, their individual contributions cannot be identified. The table does not establish that either group is independently necessary or sufficient.

paragraphs.en: Removing B reduces ID/OOD SR by 4.67/3.47 pp and increases L2 error by 0.015 m, larger changes than removing C or E. Dense and tiny-object perception share the need to preserve small spatial distinctions and separate nearby instances. Such demands plausibly recur in cluttered manipulation and distant road objects, making this supervision relevant across domains. The intervention removes the dense group as a whole; it does not disentangle object size, crowding, or annotation coverage.

paragraphs.en: Removing E reduces ID/OOD SR by 1.92/1.53 pp and leaves driving error unchanged at the displayed precision. This is a smaller marginal effect than removing B, not evidence that embodied supervision is useless: its information may overlap with other groups, and the tasks may not emphasize every affordance it teaches. Removing C causes 2.08/1.09 pp losses and a 0.002 m error increase. Existing language understanding may reduce its marginal benefit, but that explanation would require a controlled change to the language foundation.
paragraphs.zh: 移除 E 使 ID/OOD SR 分别降低 1.92/1.53 pp，而驾驶误差在所示精度下保持不变。 这一边际效应小于移除 B 的情况，但这并不意味着具身监督没有用处：其信息可能与其他组别重叠，且任务可能未强调它所教授的每一种可供性。 移除 C 导致 2.08/1.09 pp 的损失以及 0.002 m 的误差增加。 现有的语言理解能力可能降低了其边际收益，但这一解释需要对语言基础进行受控的改动才能验证。

paragraphs.en: Removing F produces the largest manipulation decreases, 5.33/3.63 pp, yet F alone is the weakest configuration. These observations establish complementarity at the group level. The full mixture is best on both manipulation metrics and ties the best displayed driving error; it is not uniquely best on every metric. Leave-one-out changes depend on the retained groups and should not be added as independent contributions. No interaction effect or OCR-only causal effect is identified by this incomplete factorial design.
paragraphs.zh: 移除 F 带来最大的操纵指标下降，为 5.33/3.63 个百分点，然而仅用 F 却是最弱的配置。 这些观察在组层面确立了互补性。 完整混合配置在两项操纵指标上均最优，并持平最优的显示驾驶误差；但它并非在每项指标上都独占最优。 留一法的变化依赖于保留的组，不应作为独立贡献进行相加。 这一不完整的因子设计无法识别任何交互效应或仅由 OCR 导致的因果效应。

paragraphs.en: Because transcription precedes coordinates, teacher-forced box prediction already conditions on the reference text. A box-only control therefore removes ℒ t \mathcal{L}_{t} while retaining protocol supervision, all transcription tokens, and the original denominator | 𝒯 | |\mathcal{T}| . Comparing it with the full loss isolates the additional transcription gradient under identical conditioning and matched training budgets. Deleting transcription tokens changes the box-prediction task; renormalizing over unmasked positions changes the weight of the retained losses.
paragraphs.zh: 由于转写先于坐标，教师强制下的框预测已经以参考文本为条件。 因此，仅使用框的控制方式在移除 ℒ t \mathcal{L}_{t} 的同时，保留了协议监督、全部转写 token 以及原始分母 | 𝒯 | |\mathcal{T}| 。 将其与完整损失进行比较，可以在相同的条件设置和匹配的训练预算下，分离出额外的转写梯度。 删除转写 token 会改变框预测任务；对未掩码位置重新归一化会改变所保留损失的权重。

paragraphs.en: We analyze how pretrained visual features reach the manipulation action interface under a new objective. These local, conditional analyses characterize feature access and adaptation; the cross-model comparisons do not isolate architectural causes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们分析了预训练视觉特征如何在一个新目标下到达操作动作接口。 这些局部、条件性的分析刻画了特征的访问与适配；跨模型比较并未隔离出架构层面的原因。

paragraphs.en: RynnBrain-2B uses Qwen3-VL with full-attention language layers ( Dang et al., 2026 ; Bai et al., 2025a ) . RynnBrain1.1-2B uses Qwen3.5 with 18 linear-attention and six full-attention layers, plus attention-output gating ( Li et al., 2026 ; Qwen Team, 2026a ) . Both employ DeepStack; here this denotes intermediate ViT-feature injection into early language layers ( Li et al., 2026 ; Bai et al., 2025a ) . Qwen3-VL injects projected features into its first three language layers. GroundingPI combines MoonViT-V2, a single visual interface, and a full-attention Qwen3-4B decoder.
paragraphs.zh: RynnBrain-2B 采用具有全注意力语言层的 Qwen3-VL（Dang et al., 2026；Bai et al., 2025a）。 RynnBrain1.1-2B 采用 Qwen3.5，包含 18 个线性注意力层和六个全注意力层，并带有注意力输出门控（Li et al., 2026；Qwen Team, 2026a）。 两者都采用 DeepStack；此处指将中间 ViT 特征注入早期语言层（Li et al., 2026；Bai et al., 2025a）。 Qwen3-VL 将投影后的特征注入其前三个语言层。 GroundingPI 结合了 MoonViT-V2、单一视觉接口以及一个全注意力的 Qwen3-4B 解码器。

paragraphs.en: RynnBrain1.1 trails RynnBrain in manipulation but improves driving, motivating analysis of task-dependent feature access. The comparison fixes downstream capacity and optimization while varying complete pretrained foundations. RynnBrain and Qwen3-VL share DeepStack, whereas GroundingPI also differs in encoder, connector, pretraining, positional treatment, and language-model scale. The Qwen2.5-VL foundations of Rex-Omni and LocateAnything leave general base-model quality as another potential influence alongside grounding specialization ( Jiang et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) .
paragraphs.zh: RynnBrain1.1 在操作任务上落后于 RynnBrain，但在驾驶任务上有所提升，这促使我们对任务依赖的特征访问方式进行分析。 该比较在固定下游容量与优化的同时，变化完整的预训练基础模型。 RynnBrain 与 Qwen3-VL 共享 DeepStack，而 GroundingPI 在编码器、连接器、预训练、位置处理和语言模型规模上也存在差异。 Rex-Omni 和 LocateAnything 所基于的 Qwen2.5-VL 基础模型，使得通用基础模型质量成为与定位专门化并列的另一个潜在影响因素（Jiang et al., 2026；Wang et al., 2026a）。

paragraphs.en: A useful design hypothesis separates knowledge-intensive deliberation from rapid perception–action execution. A planning system may benefit from extensive world knowledge, coding, and long-horizon reasoning. An execution system must translate the current goal and observations into reliable interaction while incorporating timely feedback. Existing dual-system architectures provide concrete precedents: RoboDual couples a generalist with a specialist policy, and GR00T N1 couples vision–language interpretation with a diffusion action module ( Bu et al., 2025 ; NVIDIA et al., 2025 ) . These systems motivate the distinction; they do not establish that one universal division of modules is optimal.
paragraphs.zh: 一个有用的设计假设是将知识密集的深思与快速的感知–动作执行分离开来。 规划系统可以从丰富的世界知识、代码编写和长时程推理中受益。 执行系统必须将当前目标与观测转化为可靠的交互，同时纳入及时的反馈。 现有的双系统架构提供了具体的先例：RoboDual 将通用策略与专用策略相耦合，GR00T N1 将视觉–语言解读与扩散动作模块相耦合（Bu et al., 2025；NVIDIA et al., 2025）。 这些系统为这种区分提供了依据；但它们并未证明某种通用的模块划分方式是最优的。

paragraphs.en: Here, System 1 denotes the functional perception–action execution loop. Its module boundaries need not match the naming in another architecture: GR00T N1 calls its VLM System 2 and its diffusion action module System 1. Our proposal concerns the perceptual foundation supplying an action learner, rather than identifying an unadapted grounding VLM with a complete controller. The benefit sought is precise, task-conditioned information available when an action must be selected or corrected.
paragraphs.zh: 此处，系统 1 指的是功能性的“感知—动作”执行回路。 其模块边界不必与另一种架构中的命名一致：GR00T N1 将其 VLM 称为系统 2，将其扩散动作模块称为系统 1。 我们的方案关注的是为动作学习器提供支持的感知基础，而不是把一个未经适配的接地 VLM 等同于一个完整的控制器。 所追求的收益是：在必须选择或修正动作时，能够获得精确的、由任务条件决定的信息。

paragraphs.en: The coding-agent analogy highlights the need for a dependable execution layer: increasingly sophisticated generated programs have limited practical value if they repeatedly fail to run or if their feedback cannot guide correction. In robotics, stronger plans similarly depend on correctly identifying interaction targets and executing feasible actions. Code as Policies offers a concrete connection between these roles by generating programs that combine perception outputs with control APIs ( Liang et al., 2023 ) . Our analogy motivates evaluating the complete feedback loop; it is not an empirical comparison between coding and robot-learning systems.
paragraphs.zh: 编码智能体的类比凸显了对一个可靠的执行层的需求：如果生成的程序日益复杂，却反复无法运行，或者其反馈无法指导纠正，那么其实际价值就很有限。 在机器人学中，更强的规划同样依赖于正确识别交互目标并执行可行的动作。 Code as Policies 通过生成将感知输出与控制 API 相结合的程序，为这些角色之间提供了具体的连接 ( Liang et al., 2023 ) 。 我们的类比旨在推动对完整反馈回路的评估；这并非编码系统与机器人学习系统之间的实证比较。

paragraphs.en: Dense and tiny-object grounding requires distinctions that can matter directly for interaction: which instance is intended, where it is, and which local region is relevant. Basic grounding supplies reusable localization, while OCR may complement it through local visual precision and semantic alignment. These observations suggest pretraining priorities for a foundation supporting execution. Broad semantic knowledge remains useful, but may be insufficient when the limiting factor is spatial discrimination. The controlled backbone comparison supports this concern for the evaluated Qwen- and PaliGemma-based foundations; it does not establish inferiority of every adaptation recipe or every member of the π \pi family. Grounding also leaves dynamics, contact, and feedback control to the downstream policy.
paragraphs.zh: 密集小目标定位要求对交互直接相关的区分能力：目标是哪个实例、它在哪里、以及哪个局部区域与之相关。 基础定位提供可复用的位置信息，而OCR可通过局部视觉精度与语义对齐对其加以补充。 这些观察为支持执行的基础模型指明了预训练的优先事项。 广泛的语义知识仍然有用，但当限制因素是空间判别能力时，它可能并不足够。 受控的骨干网络对比支持了对所评估的基于Qwen和PaliGemma的基础模型的这一担忧；它并不能证明每种适配方案或π \pi家族的每个成员都是较差的。 定位同样将动力学、接触和反馈控制留给下游策略处理。

paragraphs.en: Astra is a frontier reference for grounding quality in this study. Comparing a compact grounding model with it assesses how closely specialized perception can approach a strong general-purpose reference across the evaluated capabilities. It does not define a theoretical performance ceiling or evaluate Astra as a VLA backbone. Assigning a frontier model to higher-level planning and a perception-native foundation to execution is a prospective design, compatible with the observed capability differences but not tested as an integrated system here.
paragraphs.zh: 在本研究中，Astra 是用于评估落地质量的前沿参考基准。 将一个紧凑的落地模型与它进行比较，可以评估在所评测的各项能力上，专用的感知模型能够以多接近的程度逼近一个强大的通用参考基准。 它并不定义理论上的性能上限，也不将 Astra 作为 VLA 骨干进行评估。 将前沿模型分配给更高层的规划、并将感知原生的基础模型分配给执行，是一种前瞻性设计，与所观察到的能力差异相容，但本文并未将其作为一个集成系统进行测试。

sents.en: Astra is a frontier reference for grounding quality in this study.
sents.zh: 在本研究中，Astra 是用于评估落地质量的前沿参考基准。

sents.en: Comparing a compact grounding model with it assesses how closely specialized perception can approach a strong general-purpose reference across the evaluated capabilities.
sents.zh: 将一个紧凑的落地模型与它进行比较，可以评估在所评测的各项能力上，专用的感知模型能够以多接近的程度逼近一个强大的通用参考基准。

sents.en: It does not define a theoretical performance ceiling or evaluate Astra as a VLA backbone.
sents.zh: 它并不定义理论上的性能上限，也不将 Astra 作为 VLA 骨干进行评估。

sents.en: Assigning a frontier model to higher-level planning and a perception-native foundation to execution is a prospective design, compatible with the observed capability differences but not tested as an integrated system here.
sents.zh: 将前沿模型分配给更高层的规划、并将感知原生的基础模型分配给执行，是一种前瞻性设计，与所观察到的能力差异相容，但本文并未将其作为一个集成系统进行测试。

paragraphs.en: A direct evaluation would hold the planner and action expert fixed while changing the perceptual foundation, then measure task success, robustness under distribution shift, and observation-to-action latency. Perception failures should be distinguished from planning and control failures, especially for small, crowded, or ambiguous targets. Conversely, varying planner capability under a fixed execution layer would test when better reasoning helps and when interaction remains the limiting factor. The present results motivate these experiments through grounding quality, controlled action transfer, and manipulation-data efficiency; they do not yet demonstrate a real-time dual-system controller.
paragraphs.zh: 直接的评估方法应固定规划器和动作专家，仅更换感知基础模型，然后测量任务成功率、分布偏移下的鲁棒性以及从观测到动作的延迟。 应将感知失败与规划和控制失败区分开来，尤其是针对小尺寸、密集或模糊的目标。 反过来，在固定的执行层下改变规划器能力，可以检验更好的推理何时有帮助，以及交互何时仍是限制因素。 本文的结果通过基础能力质量、可控的动作迁移和操作数据效率来激发这些实验；但尚未演示实时双系统控制器。

sents.zh: 应将感知失败与规划和控制失败区分开来，尤其是针对小尺寸、密集或模糊的目标。

paragraphs.en: GroundingPI’s aggregate strength is not uniform dominance: tiny-box localization, high-IoU boundaries, TotalText OCR, FSC147 visual prompting, and frontier-level GUI grounding retain clear gaps. Prompt and parser compatibility also constrain several baseline measurements; unsupported evaluations are not evidence of absent intrinsic capability. The manipulation comparison controls the downstream recipe, but pretrained foundations differ in scale, architecture, and supervision. Driving is evaluated open loop, and action-data efficiency is tested only in manipulation. OCR-specific causality and the proposed architectural mechanisms remain hypotheses requiring matched interventions. Finally, physical prompting and complementary System-1 execution alongside frontier reasoning are directions suggested by the interface, rather than capabilities independently established by the current experiments.
paragraphs.zh: GroundingPI 的综合实力并非全面占优：小框定位、高 IoU 边界、TotalText OCR、FSC147 视觉提示以及前沿水平的 GUI grounding 仍存在明显差距。 提示词与解析器的兼容性也制约了若干基线测量结果；未被支持的评测并不代表内在能力缺失的证据。 操作对比控制了下游配方，但预训练基座在规模、架构与监督信号上各不相同。 驾驶采用开环评测，而动作数据效率仅在操作任务中进行了测试。 OCR 相关的因果性以及所提出的架构机制仍是需要匹配干预实验加以验证的假设。 最后，物理提示以及与前沿推理互补的 System-1 执行是由该接口所提示的方向，而非当前实验独立确立的能力。

paragraphs.en: The notation defined in Section 5.1 applies throughout. R and P denote recall and precision. For box grounding, the nine columns report R/P/F1 at IoU 0.50 and 0.95, followed by their mIoU aggregates. Object pointing uses point-in-mask R/P/F1. OCR uses the recorded loose-match F1 metrics; parse error is the percentage of outputs that cannot be parsed. Named dataset-family averages are unweighted arithmetic means and are reported only when every component is available. Threshold-specific and mean-overlap metrics are retained as recorded; missing recall or precision is not inferred from F1. The headline Avg is the mean of 11 independently computed capability scores. Benchmark-level results below are reported separately and do not define this average through a direct mean of their table entries. Size groups use the language backbone configuration (the 7B understanding branch for MoT models and total language-model parameters for MoE models). Qwen3.7-Max, Kimi-K2.6, Kimi-K3, and GPT-6 Astra are grouped separately in the >1T category.
paragraphs.zh: 第5.1节中定义的记号全文适用。 R 和 P 分别表示召回率和精确率。 对于框定位，九列分别报告 IoU 0.50 和 0.95 下的 R/P/F1，随后是其 mIoU 汇总值。 物体指向使用 point-in-mask R/P/F1。 OCR 使用记录的宽松匹配 F1 指标；解析错误是无法被解析的输出所占的百分比。 具名的数据集族平均值为未加权的算术平均，且仅在所有组成部分均可用时才报告。 特定阈值和平均重叠指标按记录原样保留；缺失的召回率或精确率不会从 F1 推断得出。 总体 Avg 是 11 个独立计算的能力得分的平均值。 下方的基准级结果单独报告，并不通过其表项的直接平均来定义该平均值。 规模分组使用语言骨干配置（MoT 模型使用 7B 理解分支，MoE 模型使用语言模型总参数量）。 Qwen3.7-Max、Kimi-K2.6、Kimi-K3 和 GPT-6 Astra 在 >1T 类别中单独分组。

paragraphs.en: Common and long-tailed detection use COCO ( Lin et al., 2014 ) and LVIS ( Gupta et al., 2019 ) ; dense and tiny-object detection use Dense200 ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) and VisDrone ( Zhu et al., 2018 ) . Referring grounding covers HumanRef ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) , RefCOCO and RefCOCO+ ( Yu et al., 2016 ) , and RefCOCOg ( Mao et al., 2016 ; Nagaraja et al., 2016 ) . Spatial pointing uses RefSpatial ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) and RoboSpatial ( Song et al., 2025 ) . GUI grounding uses ScreenSpot-Pro ( Li et al., 2025 ) , ScreenSpot-V2 ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , and OSWorld-G ( Xie et al., 2026 ) . OCR covers HierText ( Long et al., 2022 ) , ICDAR2015 ( Karatzas et al., 2015 ) , TotalText ( Ch’Ng & Chan, 2017 ) , and SROIE ( Huang et al., 2019 ) ; layout grounding uses DocLayNet ( Pfitzmann et al., 2022 ) and M6Doc ( Cheng et al., 2023 ) . Visual prompting uses FSC147 ( Ranjan et al., 2021 ) and exemplar-conditioned detection. RefCOCO avg is the arithmetic mean of the three family-level F1mIoU scores, distinct from the separately reported RefCOCOg validation/test columns. RefSpatial avg averages Location and Placement. ScreenSpot reports action accuracy, and OSWorld-G reports exact accuracy. Scores marked as external retain their source protocol and are not presented as locally reproduced measurements.
paragraphs.zh: 常规与长尾检测使用 COCO（Lin 等，2014）和 LVIS（Gupta 等，2019）；密集与小目标检测使用 Dense200（Jiang 等，2026）和 VisDrone（Zhu 等，2018）。 指代表达定位涵盖 HumanRef（Jiang 等，2025）、RefCOCO 和 RefCOCO+（Yu 等，2016），以及 RefCOCOg（Mao 等，2016；Nagaraja 等，2016）。 空间指向使用 RefSpatial（Zhou 等，2026）和 RoboSpatial（Song 等，2025）。 GUI 定位使用 ScreenSpot-Pro（Li 等，2025）、ScreenSpot-V2（Wu 等，2025）和 OSWorld-G（Xie 等，2026）。 OCR 涵盖 HierText（Long 等，2022）、ICDAR2015（Karatzas 等，2015）、TotalText（Ch’Ng & Chan，2017）和 SROIE（Huang 等，2019）；版面定位使用 DocLayNet（Pfitzmann 等，2022）和 M6Doc（Cheng 等，2023）。 视觉提示使用 FSC147（Ranjan 等，2021）和样本条件检测。 RefCOCO avg 是三个家族级 F1mIoU 分数的算术平均值，区别于单独报告的 RefCOCOg 验证/测试列。 RefSpatial avg 对 Location 和 Placement 取平均。 ScreenSpot 报告动作准确率，OSWorld-G 报告精确准确率。 标记为外部的分数保留其原始来源协议，不作为本地复现的测量结果呈现。

paragraphs.en: GroundingPI achieves 62.98 F1mIoU, exceeding Rex-Omni (56.28), LocateAnything Hybrid (59.12), and Astra (62.75). Its 81.16 F1 at IoU 0.50 reflects strong object coverage, but its 22.84 at IoU 0.95 trails several baselines. The aggregate gain therefore should not be read as uniformly superior boundary precision: extremely strict localization remains a limitation even on common objects.
paragraphs.zh: GroundingPI 达到 62.98 F1mIoU，超过 Rex-Omni（56.28）、LocateAnything Hybrid（59.12）和 Astra（62.75）。 其在 IoU 0.50 下的 81.16 F1 反映出较强的目标覆盖能力，但在 IoU 0.95 下的 22.84 则落后于多个基线。 因此，总体增益不应被理解为边界精度全面占优：即使在常见目标上，极其严格的定位仍是一项局限。

paragraphs.en: GroundingPI reaches 56.02 F1mIoU and 75.22 F1 at IoU 0.50, improving over Astra’s 54.97 and 72.58. SenseNova-Vision remains slightly ahead on F1mIoU (56.12) and more clearly ahead at IoU 0.95 (28.88 versus 22.42). Together with COCO, these results support broad category coverage while identifying high-IoU localization as a separate challenge.
paragraphs.zh: GroundingPI 达到 56.02 F1mIoU 和 75.22 F1@IoU 0.50，相比 Astra 的 54.97 和 72.58 有所提升。 SenseNova-Vision 在 F1mIoU 上仍略占优势（56.12），并在 IoU 0.95 上更为明显地领先（28.88 对比 22.42）。 结合 COCO 的结果，这些结果支持了广泛的类别覆盖，同时指出高 IoU 定位是一个单独的挑战。

paragraphs.en: GroundingPI attains 74.53 F1mIoU, exceeding SenseNova-Vision by 6.40 pp and Astra by 9.49 pp. At IoU 0.50, recall and precision are both high (89.88 and 92.80), indicating that the result balances finding instances and avoiding excess predictions. Its 27.85 F1 at IoU 0.95 also exceeds Astra’s 12.64. Unlike the common-object comparison, the dense-scene improvement extends to strict localization.
paragraphs.zh: GroundingPI 取得 74.53 F1mIoU，超过 SenseNova-Vision 6.40 个百分点，超过 Astra 9.49 个百分点。 在 IoU 0.50 下，召回率与精确率都很高（89.88 和 92.80），表明该结果在发现实例与避免多余预测之间取得了平衡。 其在 IoU 0.95 下的 27.85 F1 也超过了 Astra 的 12.64。 与常见目标的对比不同，密集场景下的提升延伸到了严格的定位。

paragraphs.en: GroundingPI’s 40.44 F1mIoU exceeds Astra (37.12), Rex-Omni (27.19), and LocateAnything Hybrid (28.57), but trails SenseNova-Vision (42.35) and Qwen3.7-Max (41.59). Its 3.31 F1 at IoU 0.95 remains low, as do the other results. Small absolute coordinate errors can substantially change tiny-box overlap; improved dense grounding has therefore not eliminated the precision bottleneck for tiny objects.

paragraphs.en: Following Rex-Omni ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) , SAM ( Kirillov et al., 2023 ) converts ground-truth boxes into object masks. A point is correct when it lies inside the corresponding mask. Detection-style recall, precision, and F1 are then computed; we denote the latter F1@Point.
paragraphs.zh: 沿用 Rex-Omni（Jiang et al., 2026）的做法，SAM（Kirillov et al., 2023）将真实边界框转换为物体掩码。 当一个点位于对应掩码内部时，该点被视为正确。 随后计算检测风格的召回率、精确率和 F1；我们将后者记为 F1@Point。

sents.en: A point is correct when it lies inside the corresponding mask.
sents.zh: 当一个点位于对应掩码内部时，该点被视为正确。

sents.en: Detection-style recall, precision, and F1 are then computed; we denote the latter F1@Point.
sents.zh: 随后计算检测风格的召回率、精确率和 F1；我们将后者记为 F1@Point。

paragraphs.en: GroundingPI reaches 88.79 F1@Point on HumanRef and 90.26/90.06 on RefCOCOg validation/test, exceeding Astra and the selected grounding specialists. HumanRef precision is 93.24, while recall is 84.76: target selection is reliable, but missed instances remain. The box-to-mask conversion fixes the scoring region; these results measure point correctness rather than box-boundary quality.

Its F1 advantage therefore reflects a better balance of coverage and false positives, not uniformly higher recall.

GroundingPI’s ICDAR2015 advantage is larger at IoU 0.75 than at IoU 0.50, supporting improved joint transcription and region alignment under this metric.

paragraphs.en: GroundingPI is strongest in the SROIE comparison at 72.47 F1mIoU, versus 65.49 for LocateAnything Slow NTP and 53.57 for Astra. TotalText is less favorable: GroundingPI’s 49.32 trails Astra (53.55) and Rex-Omni (52.35), despite zero parse error for all three. The remaining gap therefore concerns valid text–region predictions rather than output syntax alone; its precise source requires instance-level error analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 在 SROIE 对比中，GroundingPI 表现最强，达到 72.47 F1mIoU，而 LocateAnything Slow NTP 为 65.49，Astra 为 53.57。 TotalText 上则不那么有利：尽管三者的解析错误均为零，GroundingPI 的 49.32 仍落后于 Astra（53.55）和 Rex-Omni（52.35）。 因此，剩余差距涉及有效的文本区域预测，而非仅是输出语法问题；其确切来源需要实例级别的错误分析。

Broad gains thus coexist with a sizable frontier-model gap on professional interfaces.

paragraphs.en: GroundingPI reaches 85.08 F1mIoU, improving over DocLayout-YOLO’s reported 81.10 and Astra’s 77.54, while SenseNova-Vision leads slightly at 85.53. At IoU 0.95, GroundingPI achieves 43.47, versus 34.93 for Astra and 49.33 for SenseNova-Vision. The result supports broad document-region grounding, with the strongest specialist comparison still exposing room for tighter boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: GroundingPI 达到 85.08 F1mIoU，优于 DocLayout-YOLO 报告的 81.10 和 Astra 的 77.54，而 SenseNova-Vision 以 85.53 略微领先。 在 IoU 0.95 下，GroundingPI 达到 43.47，而 Astra 为 34.93，SenseNova-Vision 为 49.33。 该结果支持广泛的文档区域定位（grounding），同时与最强专用模型的对比仍暴露出在更精确边界方面的提升空间。

sents.en: GroundingPI reaches 85.08 F1mIoU, improving over DocLayout-YOLO’s reported 81.10 and Astra’s 77.54, while SenseNova-Vision leads slightly at 85.53.
sents.zh: GroundingPI 达到 85.08 F1mIoU，优于 DocLayout-YOLO 报告的 81.10 和 Astra 的 77.54，而 SenseNova-Vision 以 85.53 略微领先。

sents.en: At IoU 0.95, GroundingPI achieves 43.47, versus 34.93 for Astra and 49.33 for SenseNova-Vision.
sents.zh: 在 IoU 0.95 下，GroundingPI 达到 43.47，而 Astra 为 34.93，SenseNova-Vision 为 49.33。

paragraphs.en: GroundingPI reaches 74.82 F1mIoU, exceeding LocateAnything Hybrid (65.94), Slow NTP (68.35), and Astra (60.59). Its 92.31/31.83 F1 at IoU 0.50/0.95 also exceeds Astra’s 80.84/20.58. Gains across both loose and strict overlap criteria indicate that the advantage includes region coverage and localization precision, rather than only easier matching.
paragraphs.zh: GroundingPI 达到 74.82 F1mIoU，超过 LocateAnything Hybrid（65.94）、Slow NTP（68.35）和 Astra（60.59）。 其在 IoU 0.50/0.95 下的 92.31/31.83 F1 也超过 Astra 的 80.84/20.58。 在宽松和严格两种重叠标准下的提升表明，其优势涵盖区域覆盖和定位精度，而不仅仅是更容易的匹配。

sents.en: GroundingPI reaches 74.82 F1mIoU, exceeding LocateAnything Hybrid (65.94), Slow NTP (68.35), and Astra (60.59).
sents.zh: GroundingPI 达到 74.82 F1mIoU，超过 LocateAnything Hybrid（65.94）、Slow NTP（68.35）和 Astra（60.59）。

sents.en: Its 92.31/31.83 F1 at IoU 0.50/0.95 also exceeds Astra’s 80.84/20.58.
Gains across both loose and strict overlap criteria indicate that the advantage includes region coverage and localization precision, rather than only easier matching.
sents.zh: 在宽松和严格两种重叠标准下的提升表明，其优势涵盖区域覆盖和定位精度，而不仅仅是更容易的匹配。

paragraphs.en: GroundingPI reaches 87.04 F1 at IoU 0.50 but only 3.49 at IoU 0.95, yielding 57.99 F1mIoU. This slightly exceeds Rex-Omni (57.15) but trails SenseNova-Vision (62.51) and Astra (61.04). Exemplar correspondence is therefore effective at coarse overlap, while precise exemplar-conditioned box boundaries remain a clear limitation.
paragraphs.zh: GroundingPI 在 IoU 0.50 下达到 87.04 F1，但在 IoU 0.95 下仅为 3.49，F1mIoU 为 57.99。 这略高于 Rex-Omni（57.15），但低于 SenseNova-Vision（62.51）和 Astra（61.04）。 因此，示例对应在粗略重叠上是有效的，而精确的示例条件化边界框定位仍是一个明显的局限。

sents.en: GroundingPI reaches 87.04 F1 at IoU 0.50 but only 3.49 at IoU 0.95, yielding 57.99 F1mIoU.
sents.zh: GroundingPI 在 IoU 0.50 下达到 87.04 F1，但在 IoU 0.95 下仅为 3.49，F1mIoU 为 57.99。

sents.en: This slightly exceeds Rex-Omni (57.15) but trails SenseNova-Vision (62.51) and Astra (61.04).
sents.zh: 这略高于 Rex-Omni（57.15），但低于 SenseNova-Vision（62.51）和 Astra（61.04）。

sents.en: Exemplar correspondence is therefore effective at coarse overlap, while precise exemplar-conditioned box boundaries remain a clear limitation.
sents.zh: 因此，示例对应在粗略重叠上是有效的，而精确的示例条件化边界框定位仍是一个明显的局限。

paragraphs.en: GroundingPI obtains 75.43 F1mIoU, compared with Astra’s 68.94 and Rex-Omni’s 55.50. Astra has slightly higher F1 at IoU 0.50 (92.04 versus 91.88), whereas GroundingPI is substantially higher at IoU 0.95 (28.42 versus 12.29). The mean-score advantage thus reflects tighter localization, not just recognizing more exemplar-matched instances.
paragraphs.zh: GroundingPI 取得 75.43 的 F1mIoU，相比之下 Astra 为 68.94，Rex-Omni 为 55.50。 Astra 在 IoU 0.50 下的 F1 略高（92.04 对 91.88），而 GroundingPI 在 IoU 0.95 下则明显更高（28.42 对 12.29）。 因此，平均分数的优势反映的是更精确的定位，而不仅仅是识别出更多与样例匹配的实例。

sents.en: GroundingPI obtains 75.43 F1mIoU, compared with Astra’s 68.94 and Rex-Omni’s 55.50.
sents.zh: GroundingPI 取得 75.43 的 F1mIoU，相比之下 Astra 为 68.94，Rex-Omni 为 55.50。

sents.en: Astra has slightly higher F1 at IoU 0.50 (92.04 versus 91.88), whereas GroundingPI is substantially higher at IoU 0.95 (28.42 versus 12.29).
sents.zh: Astra 在 IoU 0.50 下的 F1 略高（92.04 对 91.88），而 GroundingPI 在 IoU 0.95 下则明显更高（28.42 对 12.29）。

sents.en: The mean-score advantage thus reflects tighter localization, not just recognizing more exemplar-matched instances.
sents.zh: 因此，平均分数的优势反映的是更精确的定位，而不仅仅是识别出更多与样例匹配的实例。

paragraphs.en: GroundingPI attains 82.62 F1mIoU and 71.53 F1 at IoU 0.95, versus Astra’s 68.43 and 40.54. Both mean recall and precision are high (84.03/81.25). These results support the shared coordinate vocabulary as an effective interface for visual as well as linguistic queries. Absolute scores should not be compared directly with category-prompted COCO, since the supplied target information differs.
paragraphs.zh: GroundingPI 在 IoU 0.95 下取得 82.62 F1mIoU 和 71.53 F1，而 Astra 仅为 68.43 和 40.54。 平均召回率和精确率都很高（84.03/81.25）。 这些结果支持将共享坐标词汇表作为视觉查询和语言查询的有效接口。 绝对分数不应与类别提示的 COCO 直接比较，因为所提供的目标信息不同。

sents.en: GroundingPI attains 82.62 F1mIoU and 71.53 F1 at IoU 0.95, versus Astra’s 68.43 and 40.54.
sents.zh: GroundingPI 在 IoU 0.95 下取得 82.62 F1mIoU 和 71.53 F1，而 Astra 仅为 68.43 和 40.54。

sents.en: Both mean recall and precision are high (84.03/81.25).
sents.zh: 平均召回率和精确率都很高（84.03/81.25）。

sents.en: These results support the shared coordinate vocabulary as an effective interface for visual as well as linguistic queries.
sents.zh: 这些结果支持将共享坐标词汇表作为视觉查询和语言查询的有效接口。

sents.en: Absolute scores should not be compared directly with category-prompted COCO, since the supplied target information differs.
sents.zh: 绝对分数不应与类别提示的 COCO 直接比较，因为所提供的目标信息不同。

paragraphs.en: GroundingPI reaches 78.32 F1mIoU, improving over Astra’s 64.96 and Rex-Omni’s 49.36. Mean recall and precision are balanced at 77.39/79.27, and F1 at IoU 0.95 reaches 65.86. Together with COCO, this suggests that exemplar conditioning can supply useful appearance information across category vocabularies. N/A entries for unsupported exemplar interfaces are not treated as zero-score capability measurements.
paragraphs.zh: GroundingPI 达到 78.32 F1mIoU，优于 Astra 的 64.96 和 Rex-Omni 的 49.36。 平均召回率与精确率保持均衡，为 77.39/79.27，IoU 0.95 下的 F1 达到 65.86。 结合 COCO 的结果来看，这表明样例条件可以为不同类别词表提供有用的外观信息。 对于不支持样例接口的 N/A 条目，不会被当作得分为零的能力度量。

sents.en: GroundingPI reaches 78.32 F1mIoU, improving over Astra’s 64.96 and Rex-Omni’s 49.36.
sents.zh: GroundingPI 达到 78.32 F1mIoU，优于 Astra 的 64.96 和 Rex-Omni 的 49.36。

sents.en: Mean recall and precision are balanced at 77.39/79.27, and F1 at IoU 0.95 reaches 65.86.
sents.zh: 平均召回率与精确率保持均衡，为 77.39/79.27，IoU 0.95 下的 F1 达到 65.86。

sents.en: Together with COCO, this suggests that exemplar conditioning can supply useful appearance information across category vocabularies.
sents.zh: 结合 COCO 的结果来看，这表明样例条件可以为不同类别词表提供有用的外观信息。

sents.en: N/A entries for unsupported exemplar interfaces are not treated as zero-score capability measurements.
sents.zh: 对于不支持样例接口的 N/A 条目，不会被当作得分为零的能力度量。

paragraphs.en: Language descriptions or visual exemplars could specify defects and component variants for localization, while OCR associates part markings and packaging text with their image regions. Queries can be revised as products change, and localized parts and markings provide inputs for downstream assembly checks.
paragraphs.zh: 语言描述或视觉样例可以指定缺陷和零部件变体以用于定位，同时 OCR 将零件标识和包装文本与其图像区域关联起来。 查询可以随产品变化而修订，并且被定位的零件和标识为下游装配检查提供输入。

sents.en: Language descriptions or visual exemplars could specify defects and component variants for localization, while OCR associates part markings and packaging text with their image regions.
sents.zh: 语言描述或视觉样例可以指定缺陷和零部件变体以用于定位，同时 OCR 将零件标识和包装文本与其图像区域关联起来。

sents.en: Queries can be revised as products change, and localized parts and markings provide inputs for downstream assembly checks.
sents.zh: 查询可以随产品变化而修订，并且被定位的零件和标识为下游装配检查提供输入。

paragraphs.en: On egocentric images and video keyframes, boxes and points can link descriptions such as “the cup beside the plate” or “the drawer handle” to objects, parts, and candidate interaction sites. The same query interface could support road-scene pre-annotation and retrieval of unusual obstacles, temporary signs, or construction equipment.
paragraphs.zh: 在第一人称视角图像和视频关键帧上，框和点可以将诸如“盘子旁边的杯子”或“抽屉把手”之类的描述与物体、部件以及候选交互位置关联起来。 同样的查询接口可以支持道路场景预标注，以及检索不常见的障碍物、临时标志或施工设备。

sents.en: On egocentric images and video keyframes, boxes and points can link descriptions such as “the cup beside the plate” or “the drawer handle” to objects, parts, and candidate interaction sites.
sents.zh: 在第一人称视角图像和视频关键帧上，框和点可以将诸如“盘子旁边的杯子”或“抽屉把手”之类的描述与物体、部件以及候选交互位置关联起来。

sents.en: The same query interface could support road-scene pre-annotation and retrieval of unusual obstacles, temporary signs, or construction equipment.
sents.zh: 同样的查询接口可以支持道路场景预标注，以及检索不常见的障碍物、临时标志或施工设备。

paragraphs.en: In aerial, retail, and agricultural imagery, instance localization could support ship, vehicle, product, or fruit counting. Referring expressions distinguish crowded targets by appearance or relative position, while visual examples specify unfamiliar objects that are difficult to name consistently.
paragraphs.zh: 在航空、零售和农业影像中，实例定位可以支持对船只、车辆、商品或水果的计数。 指代表达通过外观或相对位置区分拥挤的目标，而视觉示例则指定那些难以一致命名的陌生物体。

sents.en: In aerial, retail, and agricultural imagery, instance localization could support ship, vehicle, product, or fruit counting.
sents.zh: 在航空、零售和农业影像中，实例定位可以支持对船只、车辆、商品或水果的计数。

sents.en: Referring expressions distinguish crowded targets by appearance or relative position, while visual examples specify unfamiliar objects that are difficult to name consistently.
sents.zh: 指代表达通过外观或相对位置区分拥挤的目标，而视觉示例则指定那些难以一致命名的陌生物体。

paragraphs.en: Joint text recognition and region localization can retain the positions of receipt fields, package labels, and equipment markings; layout predictions additionally identify titles, tables, and figures. These spatial associations support field verification, document retrieval, and matching text to the corresponding objects or document regions.
paragraphs.zh: 联合文本识别与区域定位可以保留收据字段、包裹标签和设备标记的位置；版面预测还能进一步识别标题、表格和插图。 这些空间关联支持字段校验、文档检索，以及将文本与对应的对象或文档区域进行匹配。

sents.en: Joint text recognition and region localization can retain the positions of receipt fields, package labels, and equipment markings; layout predictions additionally identify titles, tables, and figures.
sents.zh: 联合文本识别与区域定位可以保留收据字段、包裹标签和设备标记的位置；版面预测还能进一步识别标题、表格和插图。

sents.en: These spatial associations support field verification, document retrieval, and matching text to the corresponding objects or document regions.
sents.zh: 这些空间关联支持字段校验、文档检索，以及将文本与对应的对象或文档区域进行匹配。

paragraphs.en: Requests such as “open the settings for this project” can be mapped to candidate click locations in screenshots. Combining control text, icons, and spatial context helps specify which repeated button or menu entry an interface agent should act on.
paragraphs.zh: 诸如“打开此项目的设置”之类的请求可以被映射到截图中的候选点击位置。 结合控件文本、图标和空间上下文有助于确定界面智能体应该对哪个重复的按钮或菜单项进行操作。

sents.en: Requests such as “open the settings for this project” can be mapped to candidate click locations in screenshots.
sents.zh: 诸如“打开此项目的设置”之类的请求可以被映射到截图中的候选点击位置。

sents.en: Combining control text, icons, and spatial context helps specify which repeated button or menu entry an interface agent should act on.
sents.zh: 结合控件文本、图标和空间上下文有助于确定界面智能体应该对哪个重复的按钮或菜单项进行操作。

paragraphs.en: We examine selected visualizations across grounding tasks, emphasizing the spatial and semantic demands visible in each example. Source images and their displayed annotations are preserved. Panels marked “User-curated candidate” are curated illustrations; panels marked “GT-completed display” include ground-truth completion and are not presented as raw model predictions. These examples provide qualitative context, not additional estimates of accuracy or recall. A panel marked N/A denotes an unavailable comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 我们针对若干接地任务展示了精选的可视化结果，重点呈现每个示例中可见的空间与语义要求。 源图像及其所显示的标注均予以保留。 标记为“用户整理候选”的面板为整理的示例图；标记为“真实值补全展示”的面板包含真实值补全，并非作为模型的原始预测结果呈现。 这些示例仅提供定性背景，并非对准确率或召回率的额外估计。 标记为 N/A 的面板表示对应的对比不可用。

sents.en: We examine selected visualizations across grounding tasks, emphasizing the spatial and semantic demands visible in each example.
sents.zh: 我们针对若干接地任务展示了精选的可视化结果，重点呈现每个示例中可见的空间与语义要求。

sents.en: Source images and their displayed annotations are preserved.
sents.zh: 源图像及其所显示的标注均予以保留。

sents.en: Panels marked “User-curated candidate” are curated illustrations; panels marked “GT-completed display” include ground-truth completion and are not presented as raw model predictions.
sents.zh: 标记为“用户整理候选”的面板为整理的示例图；标记为“真实值补全展示”的面板包含真实值补全，并非作为模型的原始预测结果呈现。

sents.en: These examples provide qualitative context, not additional estimates of accuracy or recall.
sents.zh: 这些示例仅提供定性背景，并非对准确率或召回率的额外估计。

sents.en: A panel marked N/A denotes an unavailable comparison.
sents.zh: 标记为 N/A 的面板表示对应的对比不可用。

paragraphs.en: Figure 12 spans children around a table, food and plates in the foreground, chairs, and densely arranged background objects. A useful structured description must separate overlapping people and furniture while retaining smaller items on the table and shelves. This scene illustrates why broad category recognition and precise instance localization must work together: recognizing the room does not determine the boundaries of each object. The supplied Ours panel is marked as a GT-completed display, so its coverage is not used to infer unedited model recall.
paragraphs.zh: 图12包含围坐在桌旁的儿童、前景中的食物与餐盘、椅子，以及密集排列的背景物体。 一个有用的结构化描述必须将相互重叠的人物与家具区分开来，同时保留桌面和货架上的较小物品。 这个场景说明了为什么宽泛的类别识别与精确的实例定位必须协同工作：识别出房间并不能确定每个物体的边界。 所提供的Ours面板被标注为经GT补全的展示，因此其覆盖范围不用于推断未经编辑的模型召回情况。

sents.en: Figure 12 spans children around a table, food and plates in the foreground, chairs, and densely arranged background objects.
sents.zh: 图12包含围坐在桌旁的儿童、前景中的食物与餐盘、椅子，以及密集排列的背景物体。

sents.en: A useful structured description must separate overlapping people and furniture while retaining smaller items on the table and shelves.
sents.zh: 一个有用的结构化描述必须将相互重叠的人物与家具区分开来，同时保留桌面和货架上的较小物品。

sents.en: This scene illustrates why broad category recognition and precise instance localization must work together: recognizing the room does not determine the boundaries of each object.
sents.zh: 这个场景说明了为什么宽泛的类别识别与精确的实例定位必须协同工作：识别出房间并不能确定每个物体的边界。

sents.en: The supplied Ours panel is marked as a GT-completed display, so its coverage is not used to infer unedited model recall.
sents.zh: 所提供的Ours面板被标注为经GT补全的展示，因此其覆盖范围不用于推断未经编辑的模型召回情况。

paragraphs.en: In Figure 13 , a top-down view places many small fruits inside a basket below a cyclist. The basket is a salient enclosing region, but the desired instance granularity concerns its contents. The comparison contrasts individual fruit boxes, overlapping proposals, and a broad container-level region. Separating partially hidden fruits requires local appearance cues and an understanding of which object level the query requests. This selected display illustrates the distinction between container recognition and instance-complete grounding.
paragraphs.zh: 在图 13 中，俯视图将许多小水果放在骑行者下方的一个篮子内。 该篮子是一个显著的包围区域，但所需的实例粒度涉及其内容物。 该对比展示了个别水果框、相互重叠的候选框，以及一个宽泛的容器级区域之间的差异。 分隔部分被遮挡的水果需要局部外观线索，以及对查询所请求的对象层级的理解。 这一选定的展示图例说明了容器识别与实例完整定位之间的区别。

sents.en: In Figure 13 , a top-down view places many small fruits inside a basket below a cyclist.
sents.zh: 在图 13 中，俯视图将许多小水果放在骑行者下方的一个篮子内。

sents.en: The basket is a salient enclosing region, but the desired instance granularity concerns its contents.
sents.zh: 该篮子是一个显著的包围区域，但所需的实例粒度涉及其内容物。

sents.en: The comparison contrasts individual fruit boxes, overlapping proposals, and a broad container-level region.
sents.zh: 该对比展示了个别水果框、相互重叠的候选框，以及一个宽泛的容器级区域之间的差异。

sents.en: Separating partially hidden fruits requires local appearance cues and an understanding of which object level the query requests.
sents.zh: 分隔部分被遮挡的水果需要局部外观线索，以及对查询所请求的对象层级的理解。

sents.en: This selected display illustrates the distinction between container recognition and instance-complete grounding.
sents.zh: 这一选定的展示图例说明了容器识别与实例完整定位之间的区别。

paragraphs.en: Figure 14 asks for the person whose hand is behind the other two people. The displayed Ours region selects the central person, matching the illustrated reference, while the comparison panels select one of the flanking people. Resolving the expression requires connecting body parts and person-level regions despite overlapping torsos and largely hidden arms. The case illustrates compositional referring: the model must identify the entity satisfying a relationship rather than simply detect a visible hand or choose a salient face.
paragraphs.zh: 图 14 要求找出手位于另外两个人身后的那个人。 所展示的 Ours 区域选中了中间的人，与图示的参考对象一致，而对比方法的面板则选中了两侧的人之一。 尽管躯干相互重叠且手臂大部分被遮挡，要解析该表达仍需将身体部位与人物级区域关联起来。 该案例展示了组合式指代：模型必须识别满足某种关系的实体，而不是简单地检测一只可见的手或选择一张显著的人脸。

sents.en: Figure 14 asks for the person whose hand is behind the other two people.
sents.zh: 图 14 要求找出手位于另外两个人身后的那个人。

sents.en: The displayed Ours region selects the central person, matching the illustrated reference, while the comparison panels select one of the flanking people.
sents.zh: 所展示的 Ours 区域选中了中间的人，与图示的参考对象一致，而对比方法的面板则选中了两侧的人之一。

sents.en: Resolving the expression requires connecting body parts and person-level regions despite overlapping torsos and largely hidden arms.
sents.zh: 尽管躯干相互重叠且手臂大部分被遮挡，要解析该表达仍需将身体部位与人物级区域关联起来。

sents.en: The case illustrates compositional referring: the model must identify the entity satisfying a relationship rather than simply detect a visible hand or choose a salient face.
sents.zh: 该案例展示了组合式指代：模型必须识别满足某种关系的实体，而不是简单地检测一只可见的手或选择一张显著的人脸。

paragraphs.en: The two similar sofas in Figure 15 create an instance-selection challenge, while cushions and a blanket divide the visible surface of the target sofa. The reference mask highlights the right sofa’s exposed regions. The displayed points illustrate different choices of instance and local surface, with the Ours point placed on an exposed seat region. For point-in-mask evaluation, predicting a nearby cushion or the other sofa can be incorrect even when a coarse bounding box would overlap the intended object.
paragraphs.zh: 图 15 中两张相似的沙发构成了实例选择的挑战，而靠垫和毯子分割了目标沙发的可见表面。 参考掩码高亮了右侧沙发外露的区域。 图中显示的点展示了实例和局部表面的不同选择，其中「Ours」点位于外露的座位区域上。 对于点在掩码内的评估而言，即使粗略的边界框可能与目标物体重叠，预测到附近的靠垫或另一张沙发仍可能是错误的。

paragraphs.en: The aerial scene in Figure 16 contains many small targets distributed across a wide field of view, with strong perspective variation and clutter from buildings, vegetation, and roads. The panels illustrate the difference between distributed instance-level points and dense runs of nearby points that can repeatedly sample one structure. The displayed Ours pattern follows the spatial distribution of the reference more closely in this selected rendering. Because the underlying query is not printed in the figure, we restrict the analysis to point distribution and avoid inferring an unshown target category.
paragraphs.zh: 图16中的航拍场景包含许多分布在宽阔视野内的小目标，并存在强烈的透视变化以及来自建筑物、植被和道路的杂波。 这些面板展示了分散的实例级点与邻近点形成的密集分布之间的差异，后者会重复采样同一结构。 在此所选渲染中，所展示的Ours模式的点分布比参考更贴近参考的空间分布。 由于图中并未打印底层查询，我们将分析限制在点的分布上，避免推断未展示的目标类别。

paragraphs.en: Figure 17 contrasts a large spreadsheet-like canvas with a small target control in the upper part of the right-side panel. The displayed Ours point aligns with the marked control, while a comparison point is drawn toward a selected central cell. The example separates semantic interface grounding from visual salience: the active cell is prominent but does not identify the requested control. Fine localization is particularly important because neighboring toolbar icons occupy only a small portion of the screenshot.
paragraphs.zh: 图 17 对比了类似电子表格的大画布与右侧面板上部的一个小目标控件。 显示的 Ours 点与标记的控件对齐，而对比点被引向一个选定的中央单元格。 该示例将语义界面定位与视觉显著性区分开来：活动单元格十分显眼，但并不能识别所请求的控件。 精细定位尤为重要，因为相邻的工具栏图标在截图中仅占很小的一部分。

sents.zh: 图 17 对比了类似电子表格的大画布与右侧面板上部的一个小目标控件。

paragraphs.en: Figure 18 mixes a large pink script word, vertical labels, small horizontal print, and a photographic background. The Ours panel identifies “Liquid” despite the enlarged, curved, and overlapping letterforms, while also localizing several smaller text regions. This combination requires separating lettering from decorative strokes and reading across markedly different spatial scales. Word-level context is helpful, but the geometry of each text region remains necessary to associate a transcription with the correct visual evidence. The display also contains imperfect small-text transcriptions, so it should not be described as error-free OCR. The case instead illustrates both the value of a strong vision–language representation for artistic lettering and the remaining difficulty of dense, layered, low-resolution print.
paragraphs.zh: 图18混合了大型粉色手写体单词、竖排标签、小型横排印刷文字以及摄影背景。 尽管字形被放大、弯曲且相互重叠，Ours面板仍识别出“Liquid”，同时还定位了多个更小的文本区域。 这种组合要求将文字与装饰性笔画分离，并在明显不同的空间尺度间进行阅读。 词级上下文很有帮助，但要建立转录与正确视觉证据之间的关联，每个文本区域的几何信息仍然必不可少。 该展示结果中也包含不完美的小字转录，因此不应将其描述为完全无误的OCR。 该案例反而同时说明了强视觉—语言表示对艺术字体的价值，以及密集、分层、低分辨率印刷文字仍然存在的困难。

paragraphs.en: The wall graphics in Figure 19 combine slanted display text, script, and short words distributed over illustrations. The Ours panel reads “BREAKING” and “BARRIERS” across the large diagonal composition and separates “LO” and “VE” on the foam-hand graphic. Recognizing these regions requires tolerance to irregular baselines, nonuniform glyph shapes, and competing decorative contours. The comparison also illustrates annotation granularity: “LO” and “VE” can be represented as two spatial text groups or combined as “LOVE”, depending on the protocol. Strong visual–language understanding helps connect unusual letterforms to coherent text, while localization preserves where that evidence occurs. The example supports a qualitative capability discussion rather than a claim that artistic reading is exclusive to a particular model family.
paragraphs.zh: 图19中的墙面图形将倾斜的展示文字、手写体和分布在插图上的短词组合在一起。 Ours面板在大型斜向构图中呈现“BREAKING”和“BARRIERS”，并在泡沫手道具图形上把“LO”和“VE”分开呈现。 识别这些区域需要对不规则基线、不均匀字形以及相互竞争的装饰性轮廓具有容忍度。 该对比还说明了标注粒度问题：“LO”和“VE”可以表示为两个空间文本组，或根据约定合并为“LOVE”。 强大的视觉—语言理解能力有助于将异常的字母形态连接为连贯文本，而定位能力则保留这些证据出现的位置。 该示例支持的是定性能力讨论，而非声称艺术性识读是某个特定模型家族独有的能力。

paragraphs.en: Figure 20 combines Dutch prose, compact numerical columns, units, percentages, barcode digits, and graphic symbols. The displayed Ours regions retain line-level text and separate numerical entries, whereas comparison panels show alternative fragmentation and transcription errors. This example requires preserving punctuation and units while distinguishing text from nearby logos and illustrations. The challenge is not only recognizing a language but maintaining the spatial associations between heterogeneous textual elements in a crowded package layout.
paragraphs.zh: 图20将荷兰语散文、紧凑的数字列、单位、百分比、条形码数字和图形符号结合在一起。 所展示的Ours区域能保留行级文本和独立的数字条目，而对比面板则出现另一种碎片化和转录错误。 该示例要求在保留标点和单位的同时，将文本与附近的标志和插图区分开来。 挑战不仅在于识别一种语言，还在于在拥挤的包装版面中保持异构文本元素之间的空间关联。

sents.en: Figure 20 combines Dutch prose, compact numerical columns, units, percentages, barcode digits, and graphic symbols.
sents.zh: 图20将荷兰语散文、紧凑的数字列、单位、百分比、条形码数字和图形符号结合在一起。

sents.en: The displayed Ours regions retain line-level text and separate numerical entries, whereas comparison panels show alternative fragmentation and transcription errors.

paragraphs.en: Figure 21 supplies a visual exemplar of a pipe opening in a tightly packed bundle. The desired unit is an individual opening, rather than the whole stack or the long metal tube extending behind it. The displayed Ours boxes retain this unit across the bundle, while the broad Rex-Omni box illustrates a group-level interpretation. Repeated dark interiors and small boundary gaps make instance separation difficult. The N/A panel is kept as an unavailable comparison and does not support a quantitative baseline claim.
paragraphs.zh: 图21提供了一个在密集堆叠的管道开口的直观示例。 所需单元是单个开口，而不是整个堆叠或延伸至其后方的长金属管。 所展示的Ours框在整个堆叠中保留了该单元，而宽大的Rex-Omni框则体现了一种组级别的解释。 重复的深色内部和小边界间隙使得实例分离变得困难。 N/A面板作为不可用的对比予以保留，不支持定量基线方面的主张。
